description:
Job Title: Marketing Virtual Assistant — Graphic Design, Content Creation &
 Marketing



Company: Wake Up Humans LLC

Location: Remote

Pay: $2.50 USD per hour

Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week



ABOUT US



Wake Up Humans LLC is Dr. Steve Judson’s platform for personal growth, leadership, and purposeful living. Through online courses, coaching, podcasts, and educational content, we help people challenge their thinking and take action toward a more intentional life.



We’re looking for a creative, organized, and dependable Marketing Virtual Assistant to help promote Dr. Judson’s courses and coaching programs. You’ll create marketing materials, develop content ideas, and write compelling copy that grows our audience and encourages course enrollments.



Learn more about Dr. Steve Judson and his courses at 
. Please review the website before applying so you’re familiar with our brand and the programs you would help promote.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Help develop marketing ideas and campaigns to promote Dr. Judson’s online courses and coaching programs.

• Create professional graphics in Canva for social media,
 campaigns, course promotions, and other marketing materials.

• Write engaging social media captions with clear calls to action.

• Develop content calendars and prepare graphics and captions for our team to review and publish.

• Write promotional
s, newsletters, welcome
s, and follow-up sequences.

• Build and format
 campaigns in our
 marketing platform.

• Repurpose podcasts, videos, and course content into graphics, quotes, carousels, short clips, and
s.

• Assist with basic video editing, subtitles, reels, and YouTube thumbnails.

• Write and refine course descriptions, landing page copy, and other promotional materials.

• Help update course pages and marketing materials in Thinkific.

• Support course launches by organizing campaign assets, deadlines, and deliverables.

• Research relevant content ideas, keywords, and opportunities to reach new audiences.

• Help track
 campaign performance and organize marketing reports.

• Keep digital files and marketing assets organized.

• Assist with other related marketing projects as needed.



This role focuses on creating content and captions. Our internal team will handle social media posting and publishing.



REQUIRED SKILLS



Graphic Design: Experience using Canva to create professional, consistent marketing materials.



Copywriting: Ability to write engaging captions, promotional copy, and course descriptions in our brand voice.



 Marketing: Experience creating and formatting newsletters, promotional campaigns, and follow-up
 sequences.



ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS



• Strong written English and proofreading skills.

• Understanding of social media content and clear calls to action.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.

• Ability to follow instructions, meet deadlines, and communicate consistently.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating with our team.

• Willingness to contribute ideas, receive feedback, and learn new tools.

• Reliable internet connection and your own computer.

• Availability to work 40 hours per week.



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



Experience with Thinkific, online course marketing, coaching brands, podcast content, CapCut, or similar video editing tools is a plus. You do not need to know every tool, but you should be willing to learn.



OUR BRAND VOICE



Our content is direct, encouraging, conversational, and focused on purpose, personal responsibility, leadership, faith, family, and growth. We want thoughtful content that sounds human and reflects Dr. Judson’s voice.



HOW TO APPLY



Please use “Wake Up Humans Marketing VA” as your application subject line and include:



A short introduction and summary of your relevant experience.



Your résumé and portfolio, including examples of graphics, social media captions, and
 copy.



A link to a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you qualify for this position. Share your relevant experience, strongest skills, and how you would help market Dr. Judson’s courses.



A list of the marketing, design,
, and video tools you have used.



Your availability and earliest start date.



Confirmation that you are comfortable with the starting rate of $2.50 USD per hour and available to work 40 hours per week.



A Loom video is required for your application to be considered. Please make sure your video link is accessible.



We’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work and is excited to help more people discover Dr. Judson’s courses and the Wake Up Humans community.

ABOUT US



Wake Up Humans LLC is Dr. Steve Judson’s platform for personal growth, leadership, and purposeful living. Through coaching, online programs, podcasts, and educational content, we help people take responsibility for their lives and pursue meaningful growth.



Our coaching framework centers on six areas: Faith, Family, Finances, Fitness, Friends, and Fun.



Learn more at 
. Please review the website before applying.



ABOUT THE POSITION



We’re looking for a confident, personable, and organized Virtual Sales & Enrollment Specialist to help us reach our goal of 100 paid online coaching members.



Your primary responsibility is to identify potential members, start genuine conversations, understand their goals, follow up consistently, and guide qualified prospects through enrollment.



This is a sales-focused position. Success will be measured by both the quality of your conversations and the paid enrollments you help generate.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Identify potential members through social media, podcast audiences, existing
 lists, previous inquiries, past participants, and referrals.



Prioritize people who have shown interest in Wake Up Humans or personal development.



Start personalized conversations through approved company accounts and outreach channels.



Respond to relevant comments, messages, and program inquiries.



Ask thoughtful questions to understand each prospect’s goals, challenges, and interest in coaching.



Determine whether the program is a good fit before recommending enrollment.



Explain the program clearly using approved information about its features, pricing, and member experience.



Answer common questions and address objections professionally.



Maintain consistent, respectful follow-up with interested prospects.



Guide qualified prospects toward a decision, share enrollment links, and confirm completed sign-ups.



Coordinate with our team when a prospect needs additional information or a conversation with Dr. Judson.



Maintain an organized lead tracker or CRM with conversation notes, lead status, and next steps.

Assist with related sales administration as needed.



OUR SALES APPROACH



We want genuine conversations that help people determine whether Wake Up Humans is right for them.



Our process is:



Connect → Understand their goals → Qualify → Explain the program → Invite → Follow up → Enroll



Every interaction should be authentic, encouraging, confident, and professional. Use accurate program information, respect requests to stop contact, and avoid pressure tactics or promises of guaranteed results.



GOALS & DAILY EXPECTATIONS



You will help build and maintain a sales pipeline toward our goal of 100 paid members. Each workday will include prospecting, outreach, responding to inquiries, follow-up, enrollment support, and reporting.



Initial activity targets may include:



25 new prospects identified per day.



15 new conversations started per day.



20 follow-ups completed per day.



5 qualified prospects per day.



3–5 enrollment conversations per day.



These are starting targets and will be adjusted with the team based on response rates, lead quality, and results.



Your daily report should include new prospects, conversations started, follow-ups completed, qualified prospects, enrollment links sent, new paid members, and any questions or obstacles.



REQUIRED SKILLS



Sales & Enrollment: Experience guiding interested prospects through a sales process and asking for the sale professionally.



Lead Generation & Outreach: Ability to identify suitable prospects and start personalized conversations.



Customer Communication & Follow-Up: Strong written English, relationship-building skills, and organized follow-through.



ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS



Experience in online sales, appointment setting, customer service, or coaching program enrollment.



Comfortable communicating through social media messages,
, and video or phone calls when needed.



Ability to ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and respond naturally.



Confidence handling common objections without becoming pushy.



Strong organization and attention to detail.



Familiarity with spreadsheets or CRM tools.



Ability to work independently, meet goals, and communicate consistently with our team.



Willingness to receive feedback and practice sales conversations.



Reliable internet connection and your own computer.



Availability to work 40 hours per week.



Experience selling online courses, memberships, coaching, or personal development programs is a plus.



TRAINING



We will provide program information, brand guidance, approved messaging, and sales process training. You will learn what members receive, who the program serves, pricing, and common questions.



Training will include practice conversations and feedback before you begin independent outreach.

Your résumé.

title: Senior YouTube Video Editor: Long Form + Shorts | Full-Time | Long-Term
description:
We are an established Australian investment education business looking for an exceptional full-time YouTube Video Editor to become a key member of our content team.

This is not a role for someone who simply removes pauses, adds captions and exports a video.

We want an editor who understands YouTube retention, storytelling, pacing and audience psychology.

We already have an experienced on-camera presenter, a substantial library of content and a 60–90 minute educational presentation recorded every week. Your job is to turn that raw material into highly watchable standalone YouTube content.

Our audience is predominantly Australians aged 40+, so we are looking for polished, intelligent and trustworthy editing rather than hyperactive editing designed for teenagers.

What you will do

- Turn a weekly 60–90 minute presentation into approximately 2–3 strong standalone YouTube videos.

- Create approximately 5–8 Shorts from the same source material.

- Edit long-form educational videos generally around 10–25 minutes.

- Find the strongest story and teaching points rather than simply editing chronologically.

- Make sure the opening delivers on the title immediately.

- Remove repetition and dead sections while preserving the presenter's natural style.

- Add B-roll, charts, screenshots, captions, lower thirds and simple motion graphics where they improve understanding.

- Create clean visual explanations of financial concepts and numbers.

- Make text and graphics clear enough to read on a television.

- Clean audio, colour-correct footage and maintain a consistent visual style.

- Work with our YouTube strategist on thumbnail concepts and packaging.

- Produce Shorts that communicate one complete idea rather than random clips.

- Maintain organised source files and project files.

- Deliver consistently and hit agreed deadlines.



What we care about

Retention and clarity matter more to us than flashy transitions.

A great editor for us can watch a 90-minute presentation, identify the 15 minutes worth publishing, restructure it if necessary, and make the viewer want to continue watching.



You should understand concepts such as:

- the first 30 seconds of a YouTube video

- pattern interruption

- open loops

- removing dead time

- matching the opening to the title/thumbnail promise

- visual storytelling

- when B-roll helps and when it distracts

- long-form versus Shorts pacing



Experience editing educational, finance, business, documentary, podcast or expert-led content is particularly useful.

Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve preferred. After Effects skills are valuable but not essential. Claude. Higgsfield. Remotion. Opus. etc. 



This role is probably NOT for you if

You need detailed instructions for every edit.

You think retention means adding a zoom or sound effect every three seconds.

You routinely miss deadlines.

You cannot explain why you made an editorial decision.

Or your portfolio consists mainly of templates rather than storytelling.

How to apply

Please send us:

1. Links to your three best long-form YouTube videos.

2. Links to your three best Shorts.

3. Tell us exactly what you personally did on each.

4. Pick one of the long-form videos and explain one editing decision you made specifically to improve retention.

5. Tell us approximately how long that video took you to edit.

6. Tell us your current workload and when you could start.

7. Tell us your expected monthly salary.



Do not send 20 links. We would rather see your three best.



Hiring process

Strong candidates will be given the same paid editing test using real source footage.

We will assess storytelling, judgement, pacing, accuracy, visual clarity, attention to detail, communication and turnaround time.

This is intended to be a long-term role with significant responsibility for the right person.

title: Senior YouTube / Google Ads Media Buyer: Demand Gen + Lead Generation + Attribution
description:
We are looking for a senior performance marketer to build and manage YouTube/Google Ads lead-generation campaigns for an established Australian investment education business.

This is not an ecommerce ROAS role.

Our funnel is:

YouTube/Google → webinar registration → attendance → engagement → eventual purchase.

That means we care about downstream economics and lead quality, not just cheap clicks or cheap form fills.

We are looking for someone who has personally managed meaningful Google Ads spend and understands YouTube conversion campaigns in depth.

Initial scope

- Google Demand Gen with YouTube channel controls

- YouTube video creative

- image creative within Demand Gen

- Google Search

- custom segments

- Customer Match

- remarketing

- audience testing

- placement analysis

- creative testing

- budget allocation

- GA4/GTM coordination

- enhanced conversions

- GCLID and UTM attribution

- offline conversion feedback

- view-through and engaged-view behaviour

- ongoing reporting and optimisation

We use a CRM and track leads through registration, attendance and eventual purchase.

The first phase is a controlled test with meaningful five-figure monthly media spend. There is scope to scale materially if the economics work.

What the weekly role looks like

Review registrations and downstream lead quality by campaign, audience and creative.

Review search terms, audience segments and placements.

Make appropriate exclusions and budget changes.

Identify creative fatigue and brief new creative.

Work with the video editor and marketing lead to develop new hooks.

Reconcile platform-reported results with CRM results.

Report clearly on what happened, why you think it happened, what you are changing and what you expect to learn.

We want someone who thinks like an investor in media spend rather than someone who merely "optimises campaigns."

You should have

Strong hands-on Google Ads experience.

Direct experience with YouTube/Demand Gen campaigns.

Substantial lead-generation experience.

Experience optimising toward downstream conversions rather than only leads.

Strong conversion tracking knowledge.

Comfort with imperfect attribution and cross-device behaviour.

Excellent analytical ability.

Experience handling meaningful monthly spend.

The ability to explain decisions simply.

Experience in Australia, financial services, education, webinars or higher-ticket acquisition is an advantage.

Meta experience is also useful because this role could eventually cover both Google and Meta.

We do NOT want

Someone whose entire solution is Performance Max.

Someone who mainly runs ecommerce Shopping campaigns.

Someone who reports impressions, CTR and CPL without understanding what happened after the lead.

Someone who outsources the actual account work to an undisclosed junior.

In your application, answer the following

1. How much monthly Google Ads spend have you personally managed?

2. What percentage was lead generation rather than ecommerce?

3. Describe your most successful YouTube/Demand Gen lead-generation campaign.

4. What was the offer, spend, CPL and downstream business outcome?

5. Tell us about a campaign that failed and what you changed.

6. How do you handle offline conversions where a lead converts days or weeks later?

7. How would you distinguish poor targeting from poor creative from a poor landing page?

8. When would you use Demand Gen rather than Performance Max?

9. Please provide screenshots or redacted evidence where appropriate.

10. Confirm whether you personally will manage the account.

11. Your hourly rate or preferred monthly retainer.

Hiring process

Shortlisted candidates will be paid to complete an account/measurement review and present their proposed first 30-day plan.

We value clear thinking over a 70-page automated audit.

The successful candidate will initially work approximately 8–12 hours per week, with scope increasing as spend increases.

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
Chief of Staff to the CEO (Remote, Philippines-based)



OPA is a group of healthcare companies in Atlanta, Georgia: home care, skilled nursing, and healthcare staffing. We are a small team and we are growing quickly. I am the founder and majority owner. I am hiring a chief of staff to be my right-hand person. I have founded and built several successful companies, and you will work with me on building this one and the others that follow. There will be opportunities for promotion for the right person.



THE JOB

A company cannot see its own problems. Somebody has to look at the work, compare it to the standard, and say plainly what they found. As my chief of staff, you do that for me across every part of the business.



You will:

- Track every commitment my managers make to me and follow each one until it is done or I drop it.

- Read the weekly financial and operating reports before I do and tell me what is wrong with them.

- Tell a manager, in writing, when a report or plan does not meet the standard, and why.

- Tell me when I am wrong, in writing, with the facts, before I d
.

- Prepare my meetings and close them out with who owns each item and the date it is due.

- Draft memos, policies, and correspondence for my review.



WHO SUCCEEDS IN THIS JOB

You are an exceptional communicator. You are diligent about your work. And you are a bulldog: once you are given something, you do not let go of it until it is finished and finished right.

You love coaching and growing people, and you know what that takes. Coaching means telling someone exactly where their work falls short of the standard, showing them what meeting it looks like, and checking the next piece of work, as many times as it takes. It is hard and often harsh. Growing people takes constant attention to that coaching.



WHO FAILS IN THIS JOB

Most of this job is conversations other people would rather not have. If you prefer to wait for a better moment, soften a finding until it stops saying anything, reply "noted" when you disagree, or report a missed deadline after it is missed, this job will be miserable for you.



I am also not looking for someone who enjoys arguing. The disagreements here are about whether work meets a standard and what something costs the company. Nothing else is worth my time or yours.



HOW WE WORK

I make the final decision. Your job is to make sure every material fact is in front of me when I make it, especially the ones nobody wanted to bring me. Once I d
, you carry it out. If new facts appear, you bring them back.

If you are behind, you tell me before the deadline.

If you raised something and nothing happened, you raise it again.

Most of your working day falls in US Eastern business hours. Some weeks run well past forty hours.



WHAT YOU NEED

- An MBA, a JD, or a comparable graduate degree.

- Excellent written English. Most of this job happens in writing.

- An operational understanding of sales and accounting, the two essential disciplines in business. You can read a profit and loss statement and a payroll report and find the line that does not belong.

- Experience reporting problems to people senior to you and getting them fixed: operations, audit, consulting, finance, legal, or project management.

- US healthcare, payroll, or billing experience helps but is not required.



PAY

USD 2,500 per month. Full-time and long-term.



HOW TO APPLY

No cover letter. Answer these three questions in writing, in under 600 words total. Applications that skip a question will not be read.

1. Describe a time you told someone senior to you that their work or decision was wrong. What did you say, what did they do, and what happened next? If they overruled you, what did you do after that?

2. A manager tells you a project is on track. The numbers you have show it will miss its date by three weeks. The manager has been with the company eight years and is well liked. You report to the CEO. Write the exact message you would send, and say who receives it.

3. Which part of this job post is weakest, and why?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid work sample and a live interview.

title: Seasoned Short Form Editor
description:
Remote · Contract · Philippine day or evening shift



We don't want to manage you. That's the job description. Everything below is detail.



You've been doing this a while. You know what a hook is, you know why the first 1.5 seconds d
 whether the rest of your cut matters, and you've matched enough brand guides to know when to follow one and when to tell someone it's fighting the platform.



What we're actually offering



Systems that already exist. Documented SOPs, a brand bible per client, a naming convention, a versioning rule, published turnaround standards, and a task queue with priorities already set before you open it. You will not spend your mornings asking what to work on or hunting for raw footage in someone's Drive.



If you've worked at agencies, you know how rare that is, and you know what the alternative costs you.



The work



Short-form video — Reels, TikToks, paid ad cuts, recuts and resizes — plus the static side: carousels, feed graphics, ad creative, flyers. Multiple clients, multiple brand voices, switched between in the same afternoon. 



What seasoned means here



Real experience cutting short-form specifically, not general video with some verticals thrown in

You've shipped volume, you can operate at moderate speed

You've held multiple client brands at once without them bleeding into each other

You think about retention and watch-through, not just whether the cut looks good

You can take a brand you've never seen, study three approved assets, and produce a fourth that belongs next to them

Revisions don't bruise you



Tools



CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Photoshop and the Adobe suite. Canva. We won't train you on these. We will absolutely train you on our clients.



Who we're looking for



We're hiring for a seat, not a project. We'd rather train one person properly over several years than churn through six editors in one. As we grow, the people who grew with us get first claim on what comes next.



You tell the truth about your work. If you missed a deadline, you say so before we find out. If the brief didn't make sense, you say that too, instead of guessing and hoping. We've never been upset with someone for saying "I don't know how to do this yet." We have been upset with silence.



You communicate without being chased. A short message saying what's done, what's stuck, and what you need is worth more than an hour of perfect work we didn't know was happening. Going quiet is the fastest way to lose this job.



You get better on purpose. You watch how other editors cut, you notice when a format is shifting, you bring an idea occasionally instead of only executing.



You move without being pushed. Empty queue, you say so. Something obviously broken, you flag it. Finished early, you ask what's next. That instinct is most of what we mean by independent, and you either have it or you don't.



You take criticism as information. Your work gets reviewed and you'll be told plainly when something misses. Editors who take feedback as an insult burn out fast. Editors who take it as data get very good, very quickly.



What we give back: honest feedback, consistent on-time pay, clear briefs, and real autonomy inside your shift. We won't ask you to pretend to be busy. If you're good, we'll keep you for years and grow the role around you.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Job description:



Ashoori Law | Full-Time | Remote | Independent Contractor



Independent Contractor Notice



This is a full-time independent contractor position, not an employee position. The selected candidate will be responsible for their own taxes, registrations, and compliance obligations in their jurisdiction.



About Ashoori Law



Ashoori Law is a U.S.-based immigration law firm serving individuals, families, entrepreneurs, investors, and businesses with their U.S. immigration needs.



We are seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead our marketing strategy, strengthen lead generation, improve conversion performance, and drive measurable business growth.



Position Overview



The Marketing Director will own the firm’s overall marketing strategy and performance. This role will oversee paid advertising, lead-generation funnels, HubSpot CRM and automation, website optimization, content strategy, analytics, and marketing attribution.



You will work directly with firm leadership and manage marketing agencies, contractors, media buyers, developers, designers, and content creators.



We are looking for a strategic leader who is also comfortable working hands-on with marketing data, systems, and execution.



Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy & Growth



Develop and execute the overall marketing and growth strategy

Establish marketing goals, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets

Identify opportunities to increase qualified leads, consultations, client acquisition, and revenue

Provide strategic recommendations and regular performance updates to leadership

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation



Oversee paid advertising across Google, Meta, YouTube, and other relevant platforms

Manage agencies, media buyers, and advertising vendors

Optimize advertising budgets, lead quality, cost per lead, and cost per booked consultation

Identify opportunities to scale high-performing acquisition channels

Funnel & Conversion Optimization



Own and improve the lead-to-consultation marketing funnel

Optimize landing pages, intake forms, follow-up systems, and consultation booking flows

Identify conversion bottlenecks and implement improvements

Develop testing strategies to improve conversion rates

HubSpot CRM & Automation



Oversee HubSpot CRM, marketing automation, and lead lifecycle management

Build and optimize
 sequences, workflows, and lead-nurturing systems

Improve lead follow-up and consultation booking rates

Ensure accurate lead tracking, attribution, and reporting

Website & Content



Oversee website performance, user experience, and conversion optimization

Coordinate improvements with developers, designers, SEO specialists, and other vendors

Lead content and digital marketing strategy

Ensure consistent, professional messaging across marketing channels

Team & Vendor Management



Lead and coordinate marketing agencies, contractors, vendors, and team members

Establish clear goals, deadlines, KPIs, and performance expectations

Evaluate performance and hold marketing partners accountable for results

Identify additional resources or capabilities needed to support growth

Reporting & Analytics



Track and report key marketing metrics, including:



Qualified leads and lead quality

Cost per lead and cost per booked consultation

Consultation booking and funnel conversion rates

Customer acquisition cost

Marketing-sourced revenue

Revenue attribution

ROAS and overall marketing ROI

Use performance data to recommend where marketing resources and budgets should be increased, reduced, or reallocated.



Required Qualifications



10+ years of progressive marketing experience, including senior-level marketing leadership

Proven experience developing and leading marketing strategies that generated measurable growth

Strong experience with paid advertising, lead generation, and conversion optimization

Advanced experience with HubSpot CRM and marketing automation

Strong understanding of marketing analytics, attribution, budgeting, and ROI

Experience managing marketing teams, agencies, contractors, and vendors

Ability to analyze performance data and translate it into actionable business decisions

Excellent communication, organization, and project management skills

Highly accountable, proactive, and results-oriented

Comfortable working directly with senior leadership in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience as a Marketing Director, Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, or similar senior marketing leader

Experience marketing legal or professional services

Experience with immigration law firm marketing

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses

Experience managing significant paid media budgets

Familiarity with compliance-sensitive industries

Performance-based bonuses may be offered based on measurable marketing results and growth.

description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Get certified in 30–60 days through consistent quality work and leadership approval.



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- You may split your shift

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Attend team/training meetings around 9 PM – 11 PM PH time (when scheduled)

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process - it must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize their brand online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent, professional English

- Clear spoken communication

- Emotional intelligence

- Be calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

title: Airbnb / Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant – Operations & Admin Support
description:
ABOUT US



GoVacation Co is a growing vacation rental management company managing short-term rental properties across the United States.



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and resourceful Virtual Assistant to help with day-to-day operations, administrative tasks, and special projects.



This is a flexible role where no two days will necessarily look the same. We're looking for someone who can take an assignment, figure out the best way to accomplish it, and follow through without needing constant supervision.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your responsibilities may include:



• Updating property listings, amenities, photos, and descriptions in Hostaway.

• Creating, updating, and managing tasks and checklists in Breezeway.

• Updating property guidebooks in TouchStay.

• Assisting with new property onboarding and setup.

• Coordinating with vendors and following up on maintenance requests.

• Researching products, services, and solutions.

• Organizing property information and operational documents.

• Creating checklists, instructions, and standard operating procedures.

• Assisting with miscellaneous administrative tasks and projects.

• Helping improve our systems and processes as the company grows.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for someone who:



• Has experience working with Airbnb, vacation rentals, or property management.

• Is familiar with Hostaway, Breezeway, Guesty, or similar software (preferred).

• Has excellent written and spoken English.

• Is organized and pays close attention to details.

• Is comfortable learning new software and technology.

• Can independently research solutions and solve problems.

• Communicates proactively and provides updates.

• Is comfortable receiving tasks throughout the day and managing priorities.

• Takes ownership of assignments and follows through until completion.



POSITION DETAILS



• Part-time: Approximately 5–15 hours per week to start.

• Flexible schedule with some availability during US business hours.

• Pay: $6–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience.

• Opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities as our company grows.

• Long-term position for the right candidate.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Tell us about your experience working with Airbnb or short-term rental companies.

2. Which property management software platforms have you used?

3. What is your desired hourly rate?

4. How many hours per week are you available?

5. Give an example of a task or project you completed independently without detailed instructions.

title: Credit Repair Dispute Manager with VA Team (DisputeFox Required)
description:
Hi there! We're a US-based credit repair company with 200+ active clients, and we're growing quickly. Most of our clients are referred to us by mortgage loan officers and real estate agents, which means our work helps real families get into homes. We're looking for a Dispute Manager with their own VA team to become our long-term backend partner as we scale.



WHAT MATTERS MOST TO US

We care more about quality and real leadership than checking boxes. The right partner is a strategic, proactive leader who owns the outcome. You'll tell us what you're seeing in our files, share what's working well for your other clients, and suggest ways we can improve.



The credit industry changes fast, and we need a leader who keeps up with it. You follow industry news and updates, adapt quickly, and think creatively (and ethically) about how to use developments like major data breaches and large credit reporting settlements in our clients' disputes.



We're analytical and love data, so we'll meet regularly to review metrics and team performance. We welcome your coaching just as much as we'll offer ours, so we can grow into a strong team together.



We have documented SOPs and specific dispute methods, and we'll work with you to blend your experience with our process. We do audit client files, so consistency with the agreed process is important to us.



WHAT YOUR TEAM WILL HANDLE

- End-to-end dispute processing for 200+ active clients, scaling beyond that

- Disputing through multiple channels: mail, CFPB, and the bureaus' online dispute portals (phone disputing is a plus)

- FTC Identity Theft Reports for our identity theft clients, filed directly through 
. Reports must be original, never edited or recreated documents.

- Following our intake rules: no disputes on outdated client documents or credit reports older than 30 days

- Follow-ups at the halfway point of each round

- Keeping every client's round and status current in DisputeFox

- Weekly reporting on rounds completed, results, and anything you notice



REQUIREMENTS

- Hands-on DisputeFox experience

- You lead a team of credit dispute VAs

- Your team disputes by mail, CFPB, and online bureau portals

- Proven methods for bankruptcies and late payments (we have many public records clients)

- Experience filing FTC Identity Theft Reports through 

- Experience managing 150+ clients at once

- Clear written and spoken English

- Available for a weekly video call during US Central business hours

- A full-time team. Working with other outsourcing clients is completely fine; we just need dependable full-time capacity.



NICE TO HAVE

- Phone disputing

- Customer service VAs with excellent English (included in your rate or as an add-on)

- GoHighLevel (GHL) automation experience, especially connected to DisputeFox

- Graphic design

-Skool automations / management

- Experience with homebuyer-focused credit clients



PAY

Flat rate per active client per month, not hourly. Our budget is $5 to $8 per client depending on what's included (disputing through multiple channels, FTC reports, customer service add-on, etc.) but we're open to negotiations. FTC report filing must be included in your per-client rate. We start with a paid pilot of 25 clients for one full round before moving the rest of our book.



HOW TO APPLY

There are no wrong answers here. We'd much rather have an honest picture of where your team is today than a perfect one. Please note that we verify references and experience before moving forward.



Start your application with the word "Partnership," then answer:

1. How many VAs are on your team? Do they share the workload, or are they dedicated to specific clients?

2. How many active clients does your team handle right now, and for how many credit repair companies?

3. How long have you used DisputeFox hands-on?

4. Which dispute channels does your team handle in-house today: mail, CFPB, online portals, phone?

5. Your per-client rate, what it includes, and your price for customer service as an add-on.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: E-commerce Operations Manager – Shopify Furniture Brand (Sourcing, Suppliers & Social Media)
description:
ABOUT US

Innist is a Los Angeles mid-century modern furniture brand selling online since 2020. We sell lounge chairs, sofas, tables, and office chairs to homeowners across the US and to businesses like offices, hotels, and design studios. We work directly with furniture factories in China and ship to customers across the country. We are small, profitable, and growing, and we're looking for one experienced, proactive person to run the store day to day and help us grow fast.



This is a long-term role with real ownership. Over your first 90 days, you'll take over running the business, with more responsibility and decision-making as you go.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Sourcing and new products (your first big priority)

- Find and source new furniture products from factories in China, and help us expand our catalog quickly

- Request real product photos, videos, specs, pricing, and lead times from factories

- Calculate landed cost (product + freight + duties + delivery) and check margins before we list

- Make sure products meet US requirements (for example, California flammability labeling)

- Launch new products quickly on Shopify



Suppliers and negotiation

- Manage relationships with our factory and suppliers

- Negotiate prices, minimum orders, payment terms, and lead times

- Track production, request finished-product photos before shipping, and handle quality issues

- Track supplier performance and help us d
 who to keep



Orders, freight, and logistics

- Process orders from start to finish and keep customers updated

- Coordinate with our freight forwarder on bookings, documents, and tracking

- Arrange delivery for large furniture items and handle damage claims



Shopify store management

- Create and update product listings: titles, descriptions, variants, photos, SEO, and alt text

- Prepare consistent product images (background removal and a standard template)

- Keep inventory, pricing, and lead times accurate

- Manage discounts, apps, and homepage updates, and check that the store runs smoothly



Customer service

- Answer customer
s and chats within 24 hours

- Handle returns, damage claims, and delivery questions

- Request reviews and collect customer photos



Marketing and growth

- Grow our Instagram,
, Pinterest, and TikTok with consistent posts (4-5 per week)

- Create lifestyle images and short videos using AI tools (we use Higgsfield), Canva, and CapCut

- Set up and run
 marketing in Klaviyo (welcome
s, abandoned cart, new arrivals)

- Help run Meta 
 and Instagram) ads and report results

- List products on
 Marketplace and refresh listings weekly

- Manage local listings (such as
 Marketplace) when we have stock available in Los Angeles



Business clients

- Respond to inquiries from offices, hotels, and interior designers with quotes

- Reach out to interior designers and businesses, and follow up on leads



Reporting and systems

- Work from our task board and send a short end-of-day update

- Send a weekly scorecard (sales, orders, customer service, problems)

- Write down every process you learn, so we build a company playbook together

- Research competitors' products, prices, and promotions



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years running or managing a Shopify store from end to end

- Experience sourcing products and working with factories or suppliers in China

- Confident negotiating prices and solving supplier and shipping problems

- Experience growing social media accounts and creating content

- Excellent written English. You'll write to US customers and business clients every day.

- Comfortable with numbers: costs, margins, and simple spreadsheets

- Organized, proactive, and able to make decisions within clear limits

- Reliable internet and backup power for outages

- At least 4 hours a day overlapping US Pacific time (9 a.m.-1 p.m. PT)



BIG PLUSES

- Experience with furniture, home goods, or other large, high-value items

- Experience with freight shipping and customs paperwork

- Experience with Klaviyo or Meta ads

- Experience with AI image or video tools, or Photoroom

- Experience sourcing on Alibaba or 1688

- Mandarin skills



PAY AND BENEFITS

- $1,000-1,600 per month, depending on experience

- Monthly performance bonus tied to sales growth

- 13th-month pay

- Philippine public holidays off, plus paid leave after probation

- Raise review at 6 months

- Long-term role with growing responsibility



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Mid-century" so we know you read this post. Then:

1. Tell us about a Shopify store you managed: what you sold, your responsibilities, and one result you're proud of.

2. Describe a time a supplier shipment or product went wrong. What did you do?

3. How would you find and launch 5 new furniture products in your first two weeks?

4. Share links to any stores or social media accounts you've managed.

5. Optional but strongly preferred: a 1-2 minute video introducing yourself (Loom or similar).



Applications without the keyword or the answers won't be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid trial task.

title: Business Development & Proposal Coordinator
description:
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor | Remote



We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and resourceful independent contractor to provide Business Development & Proposal Coordination services. This engagement will focus heavily on identifying bid and contracting opportunities, preparing and submitting proposals, researching industry opportunities, generating prospective client leads, and maintaining our sales pipeline and CRM. The contractor must maintain substantial availability during our operational hours to support time-sensitive solicitations, communications, meetings, and submission deadlines, while independently managing the manner and method used to complete assigned deliverables.



Key Responsibilities

Monitor approximately 20–25 procurement, bid, and solicitation platforms for relevant RFPs, RFQs, IFBs, subcontracting opportunities, and other solicitations.



Conduct additional research to identify opportunities that may not appear on our standard bid platforms, including prime contractor and subcontracting opportunities.



Review solicitations to determine basic eligibility, scope, deadlines, requirements, and potential fit.



Maintain a centralized bid and opportunity tracker, including due dates, pre-bid meetings, questions deadlines, addenda, submission requirements, and status.



Prepare and complete RFP/RFQ/bid responses, including assembling company information, qualifications, certifications, forms, resumes, project experience, and supporting documentation.



Manage bid and proposal deadlines from preparation through final submission, ensuring all bids are accurate, complete, and submitted on time. Timely bid preparation and submission is a critical responsibility of this position.



Research upcoming industry conferences, conventions, seminars, networking events, procurement events, outreach events, and other business-development opportunities relevant to the company's markets and services.



Identify potential clients, prime contractors, subcontractors, developers, agencies, and strategic partners for business-development outreach.



Conduct lead generation and prospect research.



Maintain the company's CRM and sales pipeline, documenting prospects, contacts, outreach, follow-ups, opportunities, next steps, and outcomes.



Manage follow-up schedules so prospective clients and opportunities do not fall through the cracks.



Respond to inbound sales leads and inquiries and route opportunities appropriately.



Assist with outbound email and other business-development outreach.



Maintain organized records of proposals, solicitations, leads, contacts, and business-development activities.



Provide regular reports and deliverables on active bids, upcoming opportunities, leads, proposal status, and sales-pipeline activity.



Qualifications

Strong online research and analytical skills.



Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



Strong command of the English language, including written and verbal communication.



Ability to manage numerous deadlines and opportunities simultaneously.



Must have experience with RFPs, RFQs, procurement, proposal coordination, business development, lead generation, or sales support.



Must have experience using CRM and sales pipeline management systems.



Comfortable researching government agencies, contractors, construction companies, and procurement websites.



Must have advanced-level Microsoft Excel skills.



Must be able to perform services independently and proactively identify and complete required deliverables rather than waiting for day-to-day direction.



Must be self-starting, self-motivated, and capable of independently determining the manner and method used to complete the work and achieve required results while using required company systems, CRM platforms, bid templates, Excel tracking sheets, and other designated tools and documentation.



Must be punctual, dependable, and highly deadline-driven for agreed meetings, communications, and submission requirements. The ability to prepare and submit bids within required timeframes is essential.



Must maintain substantial availability during the company's operational hours when necessary for bid deadlines, scheduled meetings, client or agency communications, and other time-sensitive deliverables.



Must demonstrate a high level of discretion and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding company, client, proposal, and business-development information.



Must be willing to enter into an Independent Contractor Agreement and sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) as a condition of engagement.



Engagement is subject to completion of a background check and any required authorization for the processing of personal information.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:



Construction | Public Works | Government Contracting | Labor Compliance | Prevailing Wage | Federal Contracting | Renewable Energy | Infrastructure | Professional Services | Government Procurement



What Success Looks Like

The right person will create an organized and consistent business-development process. Bid platforms are monitored routinely, qualified opportunities are identified early, proposal deadlines are tracked, submissions are organized, industry events are researched, leads are followed up on, and the CRM accurately reflects where every prospective client and opportunity stands.



This position requires someone who is proactive, persistent, organized, research-oriented, and deadline-driven. We are looking for someone who actively searches for the next opportunity and makes sure potential business is followed through from identification to submission or sales follow-up.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – US IT/MSP Market (Night Shift)
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time. This is a night shift in Manila: 11:00 PM–7:00 AM from November to March, and 10:00 PM–6:00 AM from March to November (US daylight saving time).

Compensation: $850 USD/month base + $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows + $100 USD per client that signs



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team Managed Service Providers (MSPs) rely on when challenges go beyond Tier 2 or their internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner: MSPs get access to senior-level engineers when they need them, without the cost of hiring one full time. We deliver advanced Systems Administration, Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, and Security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners. They lead implementations, resolve complex escalations, and work directly with MSP clients to deliver real-world solutions. Our outbound team is the first voice those partners hear, and that first impression matters.



Role Overview



We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to drive outbound prospecting into MSPs and IT firms across the United States. You will own the top of the funnel: working through prospect lists we provide, making high-volume outbound calls, handling objections in real time, and booking qualified discovery meetings for our leadership team.



This is a voice-first role. You will speak every day with US-based business owners, IT directors, and MSP principals, so clear, confident, natural-sounding English is essential. You’ll need to hold a real business conversation with senior decision-makers without relying on a script.



Key Responsibilities



Outbound Calling & Prospecting



Make 80–100 outbound dials per day (after a two-week ramp-up) to MSPs, IT service firms, and internal IT departments across US time zones.

Open conversations confidently with owners, principals, and IT decision-makers.

Qualify prospects against our ideal-client profile (company size, service mix, gaps in Tier 3 coverage).

Handle gatekeepers professionally and consistently reach the decision-maker.

Book qualified discovery calls directly onto the sales calendar.



Objection Handling & Conversation Quality



Respond to objections in real time without reading from a script.

Adapt tone and pacing to the person on the other end of the line.

Explain our value clearly to a technical audience without overstating technical claims.

Recognize when to disqualify a prospect quickly and move on.



Follow-Up & Pipeline Management



Run structured follow-up sequences by phone,
, and LinkedIn.

Log every call, outcome, and next step in Go High Level the same day.

Keep prospect lists clean, correcting bad data as you find it.

Nurture “not right now” prospects on a set callback schedule.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement



Report daily and weekly on dials, connects, conversations, and appointments set.

Join call reviews and act on coaching feedback.

Test and report on messaging, opening lines, and list segments.

Flag recurring objections and market feedback to leadership.

Availability

Working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

This is a night shift in the Philippines. Please apply only if you have worked a graveyard schedule before and can sustain it long term.

Some flexibility may be needed during active campaigns or event-driven outreach.

This role is not on-call, but consistent attendance during US business hours is essential.

What We Provide

Targeted prospect lists of US-based MSPs and IT firms, so your time goes into calling, not researching

A Go High Level account with built-in dialer, phone number, CRM, and direct booking to the sales calendar

Training on our services and ideal-client profile, plus ongoing call coaching

A two-week ramp-up period: your daily target is 50–60 dials while you learn our services and messaging, then moves to the full 80–100

Qualifications



Required



2+ years of outbound cold calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience in the US market.

Clear, confident spoken and written English that US business owners understand easily, with natural pacing and strong phone presence.

Proven ability to hold unscripted business conversations with senior decision-makers.

A track record of hitting dial, conversation, and appointment targets.

Comfortable working in a CRM and dialer platform. Go High Level experience is a strong plus (we provide the account).

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a backup power source, and a quality noise-cancelling headset.

Comfortable with rejection and high call volume; self-directed with minimal supervision.



Preferred



Outbound experience selling into MSPs, IT services, or B2B technology.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365, cloud, or managed IT terminology.

Hands-on Go High Level experience (calling, pipelines, calendar booking, follow-up workflows).

Experience researching prospects (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to personalize outreach.

Compensation

Base: $850 USD per month, paid twice monthly.

Appointment commission: $25 USD for every qualified appointment that takes place.

Conversion bonus: $100 USD for every prospect who signs on for services after a meeting you booked.

No minimum threshold. Commission is paid from your first qualified appointment.

Engagement type: Independent contractor. Payment method: bank transfer via Gusto HR system



What counts as a qualified appointment



The meeting must actually take place, and the person on the call must be a decision-maker or decision-influencer: an owner, principal, partner, CEO, CTO, IT director, IT manager, service manager, or operations manager. A help desk technician, receptionist, or office administrator does not count, even if they agreed to the meeting. Our sales team confirms each attendee’s role after the meeting, and you’ll see the result in Go High Level.



Reschedules don’t affect commission. If the meeting eventually happens with a qualifying contact, you are paid. Appointments that never take place are not paid.



Conversion bonus



If a prospect you booked signs a services agreement with T3 Tech Partners within 90 days of the meeting taking place, you receive an extra $100 USD, paid on signature. There is no cap.



What this adds up to



At a normal pace of 15 to 20 held appointments per month, base plus commission comes to $1,225–$1,350. Two signed clients in a month brings that to $1,425–$1,550.



How to Apply – Audio Sample Required



Applications without an audio sample will not be reviewed. It’s the first thing we check.



This role is judged on how you sound on the phone, so please record a 60–90 second voice sample yourself, in your own voice, in one take. Cover:



Your name and where you’re based.

A brief summary of your outbound calling experience and the markets you’ve called into.

A mock cold call opener: you’ve just reached the owner of a US-based MSP who wasn’t expecting your call. Deliver your first 20–30 seconds exactly as you would on a real dial.

How you’d respond if that owner said, “We already have an internal engineer for that.”



How to send it



Record with any free tool, then paste the shareable link into the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph. Options that work well:



Vocaroo (
): records in your browser, no account needed, instant link

Voice Spice (
): browser-based recorder with a shareable link

Clyp (
): free hosting with a direct link

Google Drive or Dropbox: record on your phone, upload, and share



Make sure anyone with the link can listen. We can’t chase permission requests, and locked links count as no submission.



In your chat message, please include:



The word Tier3 as the first word of your message (so we know you read the full post)

Your audio link

Your resume or a link to it

The number of outbound dials you typically made per day in your last role

Confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, and whether you’ve worked a night shift before



We review every application that includes an audio sample. Strong candidates will be invited to a short live phone screen, where, once again, how you sound matters most.
