title: Video Editor - YouTube Specialist
description:
Role Overview



“Can I keep shrimp with my betta?”



“What should I put in my first five-gallon aquarium?”



“Why aren’t my shrimp thriving?”



These are the kinds of questions our customers ask. We’re building a recurring expert-led video program that gives them useful answers, helps them make confident decisions, and brings more people into the aquarium hobby.



We’re looking for a Video Editor - YouTube Specialist to turn those live Q&As and recorded conversations into a consistent library of compelling and viral trending content.



Shrimpy Business sells freshwater shrimp, fish, snails, aquatic plants, and aquarium supplies through 
. Our ambition is to help customers build thriving aquariums and become part of a community they want to return to.



You will work with our on-camera host, subject-matter experts, and brand team. They will bring the conversations and expertise; you will shape the footage into videos that work for viewers discovering the topic for the first time.



One session might become an edited YouTube episode, several focused videos answering individual questions, and a selection of Shorts and social clips. You will identify what deserves its own video, build a strong opening, preserve the meaning of the expert’s answer, and adapt the edit to each format.



This role requires editorial judgment as well as technical skill. You should be able to watch a long recording, recognize the most useful moments, and turn them into clear, engaging videos without needing someone to mark every cut.



This is a fully remote position for a Philippines-based editor. Working hours, deadlines, and any required overlap with the US team will be agreed during the hiring process.



Why oCommerce



oCommerce buys, builds, and operates consumer businesses with shared creative, marketing, technology, ecommerce, and operational expertise.



Your initial focus will be Shrimpy Business. You will work with the brand team and relevant specialists to build a repeatable video workflow, with direct feedback on what gets published and how viewers respond.



The opportunity is to help establish an ongoing educational and community program, with a recognizable style and a growing library of useful content.





Key Responsibilities



Edit raw videos into compelling YouTube episodes. Remove unnecessary waiting, repetition, technical interruptions, and tangents. Structure the conversation so viewers can follow it while preserving the host’s personality and the expert’s meaning.

Create focused videos from individual questions. Identify answers that can stand on their own, such as choosing beginner shrimp, understanding water parameters, acclimating livestock, or selecting compatible tankmates. Include enough context for someone who has not watched the original session.

Find and edit the strongest short-form moments. Turn useful answers, surprising explanations, demonstrations, and memorable exchanges into YouTube Shorts and social clips. Give each clip a clear opening, a worthwhile payoff, and a natural ending.

Adapt content across aspect ratios. Produce landscape 16:9 videos, vertical 9:16 edits, and square 1:1 or portrait 4:5 versions where needed. Reframe intentionally so the host, aquarium footage, graphics, and captions remain readable.

Make aquarium content visually clear. Use relevant tank footage, species close-ups, demonstrations, labels, and simple graphics to support the explanation. Match visuals to the species or process being discussed and flag missing footage.

Protect the accuracy of expert advice. Preserve conditions and qualifications that affect an answer—for example, tank size, species, water conditions, or individual fish behavior. Ask the host or expert to review uncertain statements, terminology, and captions.

Deliver clean audio and consistent visuals. Improve dialogue clarity, balance sound levels, correct color, synchronize footage, and use music thoughtfully. Keep speech easy to understand and aquarium detail visible.

Create accurate, readable captions. Check automated transcripts, especially species names and aquarium terminology. Adapt caption placement and pacing to the format.

Support YouTube packaging. Propose clear titles, thumbnail concepts, opening hooks, descriptions, chapters, and relevant next-video suggestions. Coordinate with the design and brand teams so the packaging accurately represents the content.

Prepare publishing-ready deliveries. Supply final exports, caption files, thumbnail assets or briefs, and supporting copy in the agreed formats. Coordinate uploads, scheduling, and final checks with the person responsible for publishing.

Support content beyond the channel. Provide clean transcripts, timestamps, and relevant clips to teammates creating website articles, FAQs,
 content, and social posts.

Connect useful advice with relevant next steps. Where appropriate, incorporate an approved product, bundle, care guide, or related-video recommendation that follows naturally from the topic.

Improve edits using viewer response. Review retention, watch time, thumbnail click-through rate, Shorts performance, and comments with the team. Identify where viewers lose interest or need more clarity, and apply those lessons to future videos.

Keep the production workflow organized. Manage footage, project files, linked assets, versions, feedback, and exports. Maintain a clear queue so the team knows what is being edited, reviewed, and prepared for release.

Give the recording team useful feedback. Flag recurring audio, framing, pacing, or coverage problems and suggest practical improvements that will make future sessions easier to edit.

The Content You’ll Work On — Topics may include:

Choosing a first aquarium or a first pet for a child.

Planning beginner and small-tank setups.

Shrimp, snail, and fish compatibility.

Water parameters, hard tap water, and remineralization.

Acclimation, feeding, algae, breeding, and maintenance.

Customer tank showcases and aquascape stories.

Product demonstrations and practical recommendations.

Our goal is to make expert knowledge accessible while helping viewers d
 what is appropriate for their own aquarium.

Your Opening Mandate: First 60–90 Days — First 30 days: Learn the brand, audience, footage sources, and review process. Establish editing templates, file organization, caption styling, and delivery standards. Complete an initial set of long-form and short-form edits.

Days 31–60: Build a dependable workflow from recorded session to edited episode, focused answer videos, and social clips. Recommend improvements to recording and content packaging.

Days 61–90: Use early performance data and team feedback to improve openings, pacing, topic selection, and repurposing. Help establish a sustainable release schedule.

We will agree output targets based on recording frequency, footage length, editing complexity, and available support.





Qualifications & Skills

A portfolio demonstrating strong YouTube editing, including both long-form videos and Shorts. Explain which parts you personally edited or developed.

Experience editing interviews, podcasts, livestream recordings, educational videos, or other dialogue-led content.

Strong editorial judgment. You can find the central question, identify the useful answer, and remove material that slows the video down.

Proficiency in a professional editing application such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro.

Practical skills in audio cleanup, color correction, captions, basic motion graphics, and delivery across multiple aspect ratios.

Understanding of YouTube viewer behavior and packaging, including openings, pacing, titles, thumbnails, and audience retention.

Strong English comprehension and writing skills. You can follow unscripted conversations, correct captions, and recognize when an edit changes the speaker’s meaning.

Ability to work independently, manage several deliverables from one recording, and incorporate feedback reliably.

A computer capable of handling the footage and projects required for the role, reliable internet, and sufficient storage for an organized remote workflow.

Willingness to learn aquarium terminology and seek expert clarification where necessary.

Thoughtful use of AI-assisted transcription, captioning, footage search, and editing tools, with careful human review.

Experience Especially Relevant to This Role — Educational YouTube channels: Helpful for making complex explanations clear and engaging.

Podcast or livestream repurposing: Helpful for finding standalone videos within longer conversations.

Science, pets, nature, or hobby content: Helpful for working with technical terms and visually demonstrating advice.

Thumbnail and title development: Helpful for connecting the edit with the reason a viewer chooses to watch.

Aquarium keeping or aquascaping: A welcome advantage, though it is not required.

What we're looking for

Someone who can turn a long recording into a clear editorial plan.

Someone who recognizes when a short clip needs one more sentence of context.

Someone who understands that a strong hook should accurately represent the answer.

Someone who can make an explanation engaging through thoughtful pacing and useful visuals.

Someone who checks whether a caption, species image, or graphic is correct.

Someone who can adapt a video for vertical viewing while keeping the important action visible.

Someone who takes feedback well and can explain the reasoning behind an edit.

Someone who cares about both the quality of each video and the reliability of the ongoing workflow.





What we offer

A fully remote role based in the Philippines. Work with a distributed team under agreed collaboration hours and delivery expectations.

A clear creative focus. Help build Shrimpy Business’s YouTube and short-form content program.

Recurring original footage. Work with expert Q&As, real conversations, demonstrations, and community stories.

Editorial ownership. Contribute to structure, hooks, packaging, and the choice of moments worth publishing.

Direct feedback on results. See how viewers respond and use that evidence to improve your work.

Collaboration with specialists. Work alongside the host, subject-matter experts, brand team, and relevant creative and marketing colleagues.

Compensation reflecting your experience and the scope. We will discuss the package and working arrangements transparently during the introductory conversation.





Our hiring process

title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
Real Estate Operations Manager: 



We are a nationwide real estate investment company looking for an exceptional Real Estate Operations Manager with prior Transaction Coordinator experience.



Prior TC experience is REQUIRED. Experience with wholesaling, novations, or real estate investing is strongly preferred.



This role is for someone who is excellent at the mechanics of transactions but is also an exceptional problem solver.



We do NOT want someone whose job ends at sending paperwork, updating a CRM, and reminding people about deadlines.



We want someone who owns the transaction from signed contract through closing.



----



What You'll Own:



- All seller communication after contract

- Title/escrow/attorney coordination

- Agent and MLS coordination

- Inspections, access, showings and lockboxes

- Payoffs, liens, title problems and missing documents

- Buyer/lender/closing issues

- Transaction deadlines and follow-up

- Sellers becoming nervous, confused, frustrated or wanting to back out

- Problems threatening the transaction

- Keeping every party moving toward closing

- Escalating to the owner only when his actual authority or judgment is required



The Most Important Part: Problem Solving



We are specifically looking for someone who solves problems instead of reporting problems.



----



Musts: 



- Previous Transaction Coordinator experience

- Experience managing real estate transactions from contract through closing

- Strong understanding of title/escrow/closing processes

- Exceptional problem-solving ability

- Excellent seller/customer communication

- High emotional intelligence

- Strong assertiveness and persistence

- Excellent organization and attention to detail

- Ability to handle difficult conversations without becoming flustered

- Ability to make decisions independently within your authority

- A habit of relentlessly following up until something is resolved

Wholesale, novation, acquisitions/dispositions, or investor transaction experience is a major advantage.



------



The Personality



We're looking for an empathetic bulldog.



You can spend 20 minutes calming down an anxious seller and make them feel completely heard.



Five minutes later, you can call a title company for the third time that day because we're still waiting on something required to close.



You're kind without being passive.



You're assertive without being abrasive.



And when something goes wrong, your instinct is:



“I'll figure it out.”



----



To Apply



Please answer:



1. How many real estate transactions have you personally coordinated from contract through closing?

2. What types of transactions have you handled? Include wholesale, novation, cash, retail/MLS, creative finance, etc.

3. Tell us about the hardest transaction problem you've personally solved. What happened, what did YOU do, and what was the outcome?

4. A seller calls and says, “I've changed my mind. I'm not selling anymore.” Walk us through exactly how you would handle the conversation and what you would do afterward.

5. Tell us about a transaction you personally saved that otherwise might not have closed.

Generic applications will not be considered.



We are hiring for transaction experience, judgment, persistence, empathy, and extreme ownership—not someone who simply processes paperwork.

title: Pricing and Promotions Analyst
description:
Company: Cosmo Appliances



POSITION OVERVIEW



The Sales Promotions and Pricing Analyst supports the planning, preparation, and submission of promotional campaigns across multiple sales channels. This role is responsible for ensuring promotions are submitted correctly, tracked, and confirmed before deadlines.



The position requires strong organizational skills, advanced Excel proficiency, and consistent follow-through. The assistant will work closely with management and internal teams to gather required data for promotions and ensure all information is accurate before submission.



This role requires a high level of responsibility and accountability, as promotions must be monitored and followed up on until they are fully confirmed and scheduled.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Promotion Submission & Tracking

• Prepare and submit promotional requests across sales channels and retailer portals.

• Maintain organized records of all promotion submissions, approvals, and campaign details.

• Track promotions from submission through confirmation to ensure they are properly scheduled.

• Follow up with partners or internal teams until promotions are fully confirmed.



Follow-Up & Coordination

• Follow up with management and relevant departments to gather all required data needed for promotion submissions.

• Ensure promotional details such as pricing, product lists, discount structures, and campaign dates are complete before deadlines.

• Monitor upcoming promotional deadlines and proactively communicate missing information.



Data Management & Excel Responsibilities

• Use advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills to perform calculations related to promotional pricing, margins, discounts, and campaign planning.

• Create and maintain spreadsheets used for tracking promotions, pricing adjustments, and campaign performance.

• Review calculations and verify promotional data accuracy before submissions are made.



Accountability & Process Ownership

• Take ownership of assigned promotional campaigns and ensure they are completed accurately and on time.

• Maintain clear tracking of pending submissions and follow up regularly until confirmations are received.

• Communicate status updates to management regarding promotion approvals and outstanding items.



Accuracy & Issue Resolution

• Maintain a high level of attention to detail when preparing promotional submissions and calculations.

• If mistakes occur, take responsibility for identifying the issue and correcting it promptly.

• Work proactively to investigate discrepancies and ensure errors are resolved quickly and properly.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• 3-5 years of experience in marketing, promotions, pricing analysis and pricing management, sales support, or administrative coordination preferred.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

• Strong communication and follow-up skills.



PREFERRED SKILLS



• Experience with retail or e-commerce promotional campaigns.

• Familiarity with retailer portals or online marketplace systems.

• Experience managing promotional calendars or campaign trackers.



KEY TRAITS



• Accountability – Takes ownership of assigned tasks and follows through until completed.

• Responsibility – Maintains accuracy and reliability when handling promotions and calculations.

• Proactive Communication – Follows up with management and teams to gather required information.

• Attention to Detail – Ensures promotional pricing and calculations are accurate.

• Organization – Maintains clear records and tracking systems for promotions.



IMPORTANT EXPECTATIONS



Promotions often involve multiple deadlines and stakeholders. The Sales Promotions Assistant must be comfortable following up with management and internal teams to gather required data and ensuring promotions are completed and confirmed on time.



Accuracy and accountability are critical in this role. If errors occur, the expectation is that the individual takes responsibility, works quickly to resolve the issue, and implements corrections to prevent repeat mistakes.

About Glow Up Hub

Glow Up Hub is an AI platform for beauty salon owners. Owners upload their own policies and procedures, and their staff get instant, accurate answers from the platform instead of texting the boss. We are a small, founder-led team getting ready to launch.



The role

Your goal is to get as many salons signed up as possible, by any ethical route that works. That includes everyday salons who sign up on their own/ low touch point, larger accounts (franchises and chains, salon groups with three or more locations, top tier accounts), and sales driven by influencers, beauty coaches, affiliates and referral partners, plus media and PR outreach and award entries, which are a main part of the role. All your communication is written, by
 and message, with no phone calls. You will be measured on paying salons signed up through your channels with bonuses/ pay increases to be determined after an agreed upon amount of time.



What you will do

Your work falls into six areas: everyday salons, larger accounts, influencers, beauty coaches and affiliates, referrals and partnerships, media, PR and awards, and reporting.





Everyday salons (low touch/ no touch signups),



Find independent salon owners across Australia and New Zealand, and message them with a clear reason to try Glow Up Hub and a link to sign up. Getting stand alone salons signing up will be your main focus initially

Join salon owner groups and communities, and turn useful conversations into signups

Follow up with people who showed interest or started signing up but did not finish, using lists we share

Reply personally to warm leads and interested salon owners from social, ads and groups, so no interest goes cold

Test new channels and report which ones bring in paying salons at the lowest effort





Larger accounts (top tier and enterprise),



Build target lists of franchises and chains, salon groups with three or more locations, and large salons likely to suit the top tier. This will be further into your role once we have a certain amount of salons already signed up

Reach out by

title: Meta ads Video editor
description:
About us



We’re an e-commerce brand that makes work pants and workwear for tradespeople in the UK and US. We’ve sold 156,000+ pairs. We run a high-volume creative system on Meta 
 and Instagram). Our scripts are written and finished before they reach you, so your job is to turn them into ads that stop the scroll and sell.



What you’ll be editing



Every batch comes as a written brief that includes:



- A reference ad, which is a proven winning ad (a Google Drive link). We match its pacing, structure and feel closely, but we don’t copy it.

- 5 hooks and one shared body script. You cut 5 versions of the same ad with a different opening each time.

- A beat-by-beat breakdown with the line spoken, the visual direction and the on-screen text for each beat.

Our B-roll bank and assets, so you aren’t starting from nothing.



Ads are usually 20 to 60 seconds and vertical (9:16). The format changes from batch to batch, and you need to be able to make all of them, including:



- UGC-style rants and customer testimonials

- AI talking heads (an AI-generated person speaking to camera)

- AI podcast clips (two hosts at a mic, discussing the product)

- Claymation and other stylised AI animation

- Skits and POV ads

- Brand comparisons (us vs. the competition)

- Whatever new format is working that week, matched to the reference ad



Responsibilities



- Edit 5-hook batches of short-form vertical video ads from a written brief and reference ad

- Follow the brief exactly. Scripts are already approved, so you don’t change wording or claims.

- Build AI-generated formats from scratch in Higgsfield (talking heads, podcast scenes, claymation, generated footage and product shots) when the reference ad calls for it

- Use ElevenLabs for AI voiceovers that sound natural, with the right accent, emphasis and delivery

- Add captions and on-screen text overlays in our house style (sentence case, clean, readable on mobile)

- Add sound effects and music that suit the pace of the ad

- Turn revisions around quickly

- Name and organise files exactly as instructed



Requirements



- 2+ years editing short-form ads (Meta, TikTok or UGC-style direct response). Organic content alone isn’t enough.

- You must already know how to use Higgsfield and ElevenLabs. These are the platforms we use, and we won’t train you on them. Please confirm in your application that you’ve used both and say what you’ve made with them.

- Range across formats. You can go from a UGC rant to an AI podcast to a claymation ad without it looking amateur.

- Strong English comprehension. You need to hear and feel the pacing, accent, emphasis and tone of a UK or US voice. You’ll be matching a reference ad’s delivery and directing AI voiceovers, so a voice that’s slightly off kills the ad.

- Proficient in Premiere Pro, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve

- You understand what makes a hook work in the first 3 seconds, along with pacing, pattern interrupts and retention

- Attention to detail. Our briefs are specific, and the small things matter. To show us you read this far, write “blue folder” somewhere in your application.

- Reliable internet and a capable computer

- Comfortable working with Google Drive and Google Sheets

- Willing to complete a paid trial task before being hired (details below)



Nice to have



- Experience editing ads for apparel, workwear or e-commerce brands



Our hiring process (all steps required)



Apply with:

- Your portfolio: ad work only, with links to at least 3 ads you edited, plus a screenshot of the editing timeline for each one. We want to see how you build an edit, not just the finished result. Bonus points if at least one is a fully AI-generated format (talking head, podcast, claymation, etc.).

- A short video of yourself (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself, your editing experience, and the AI tools you use. Upload it to Google Drive, Loom or YouTube (unlisted is fine) and include the link.

- Genius U personality test. Take the free Genius Test here: 
. Include your result (your profile name plus a screenshot or link) in your application.

- Video interview. Shortlisted applicants will have a recorded or live video interview with us.

- Paid trial task ($7.50 USD). You’ll edit one real brief from our system: 1 body script and 2 hooks, using our B-roll bank. You get paid for it whether or not you’re hired.



How to apply



Include:



- Portfolio links (ads only) with timeline screenshots for each

- The link to your video introduction

- To check you're paying attention write “blue folder” somewhere in your application

- Confirmation that you can use Higgsfield and ElevenLabs, with what you’ve made in each

- Which of the formats above you’ve already made

Confirmation that you’re willing to do the $7.50 paid trial task

The ideal candidate should be comfortable speaking with U.S.-based borrowers and commercial loan brokers and explaining lender-approved loan terms in a clear, professional, and confident manner.

* Handle inbound and outbound calls with borrowers and brokers

* Explain lender-approved Term Sheets

* Review basic loan terms such as:

 * Loan amount

 * Interest rate

 * Loan term

 * Interest-only payments

 * LTV / CLTV

 * Lender points

 * Lien position

 * Recourse

 * Closing conditions

* Explain underwriting and due diligence deposit requirements

* Approve loans

* Change lender points

* Reduce underwriting deposits

* Modify closing conditions

* Change wire instructions

* Promise funding or closing without management approval



Any request to modify approved terms must be referred to Medina Real Estate Solutions LLC management.



Wire Security



The agent may only verify wire instructions that have already been officially approved and issued by Medina.



The agent must never independently create, alter, or substitute banking instructions.



Requirements



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Strong and professional phone presence

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. borrowers and brokers

* Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:

 * Mortgage lending

 * Private lending

 * Commercial lending

 * Loan officer assistance

 * Real estate finance

* Good understanding of lending terminology

* Strong attention to detail

* Calm and professional when handling objections

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet work environment

* Ability to take calls during U.S. business hours

* Ability to respond quickly when a call is requested



Schedule



This is an on-call / as-needed role.



The agent should maintain availability during agreed U.S. business hours but will only be asked to work when there is an active borrower or broker call, follow-up, or loan-related task.



Some days may have no calls.

You will speak directly with homeowners who have already shown interest in selling their property. Your job is to build rapport, understand their situation, qualify the opportunity, present offers, consistently follow up, and help move qualified sellers toward a signed agreement. 



This is not a cold-calling-only position. Our company generates the leads, provides the CRM, systems, training, offer guidance, contracts, and closing support. Your focus is communicating with sellers and converting opportunities.



What you’ll do:

• Call and follow up with incoming and qualified seller leads

• Understand seller motivation, timeline, property condition, and price expectations

• Build rapport and professionally handle objections

• Present cash and alternative purchase options

• Maintain accurate notes and follow-up tasks in our CRM

• Follow up consistently with warm opportunities

• Work with management to move accepted offers toward contract



Who we’re looking for:

• Strong spoken English and communication skills

• Confident and comfortable speaking on the phone

• Sales experience preferred

• Real estate experience is a plus, but not required

• Coachable and willing to follow a proven sales process

• Organized and dependable

• Competitive and motivated by performance-based compensation

• Comfortable handling objections and negotiating

• Able to work independently in a remote environment



Compensation & Growth:

• Starting base pay: $3/hour during probation

• $150–$400 commission per closed transaction

• Base pay increases available every quarter based on performance

• Company handles transaction coordination and closing

• Training and ongoing coaching provided

• Opportunity to advance into a full Acquisition Manager position

• Long-term contracts of up to 2 years may be offered after successful completion of probation



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with our company, not someone looking for a temporary position.



When applying, please briefly describe your previous sales, real estate, appointment-setting, or phone experience.

title: Technical Support & Client Onboarding Specialist (GoHighLevel)
description:
Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time 40 hours per week. Strong candidates who can only do 20 hours will also be considered.

Hours: Day shift in the Philippines: 6am-2pm PHT (8am-4pm AEST). No night shift.

Pay: AUD 2,000-2,400 per month base (full-time), plus an AUD 300 per month client-facing allowance: AUD 2,300 per month to start. Part-time is pro rata, allowance included.



PROGRESSION

Everyone starts at Level 1 while they learn our system and how we operate. If your GoHighLevel knowledge proves strong, you move to Level 2 as soon as you have finished initial training and meet the Level 2 bar, with no minimum waiting time.



- Level 1 (start): AUD 2,000-2,400 base / 2,300-2,700 with allowance

- Level 2: AUD 2,500-2,900 base / 2,800-3,200 with allowance

- Level 3 (senior technical): AUD 3,000-4,000 base / 3,300-4,300 with allowance



Each step has written criteria. Pay moves on what you can do, not on time served.



WHO WE ARE

Pipereply builds and runs customised CRM systems for Australian solar and trade businesses, built around GoHighLevel with custom automations, integrations and AI assistants. We are a small remote team with a relaxed, no-BS culture, high standards and long-term relationships.



THE ROLE

Two halves:

1. Support. Work our help desk: workflow issues, form and calendar problems, integration failures and client questions. Find the cause, fix it properly, and confirm it is fixed before you close it.

2. Client calls. Run short video calls (30-60 minutes) with new clients to set them up on our new product, and walk existing clients through features such as calendars. You are the friendly, clear voice of Pipereply on these calls.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE HERE

- You understand the client's real question before you answer it. If it is unclear, you ask.

- You finish the job. A ticket is closed when the client's problem is solved, not when you have replied.

- You take initiative. If you see something else wrong while you are in there, you raise it.

- You use AI to work faster, and you check its answers before acting on them.



MUST HAVE

- 2+ years hands-on GoHighLevel: workflows, calendars, forms, pipelines, conversations. Operations or support experience, not marketing-only.

- Confident spoken English. You are comfortable leading a video call with a business owner and explaining technical things in plain words.

- Clear written English.

- Initiative and follow-through, as above.



NICE TO HAVE

- Debugging experience: execution logs, webhooks, API testing (Postman), reading JSON.

- Twilio, Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Workspace.

- Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic tools.



WHY WORK WITH US

- Daytime hours in the Philippines.

- A transparent level structure with written criteria for each pay step. You will know exactly how to earn more.

- Long-term work with a small team that values quality over speed.



EXPECTATIONS

- 100% remote. Available 8am-4pm AEST, including a short daily stand-up.

- Disclose any other ongoing roles or clients.

- List this engagement on LinkedIn as an independent contractor.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

1. Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. In the first line of your message, tell us which GoHighLevel feature you know best and why.

2. Complete our application form: 
/widget/survey/qyJWTwBa93Yvp1r0Neql



We only consider applicants who complete both steps and have 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience. Shortlisted applicants are invited to a short recorded video round, then an interview.

title: Virtual Vehicle Service Advisor (Technical & Operations)
description:
About Us



C&G Autos is a high-performing independent car repair and service centre based in Slough, UK. With 600 Google reviews and a 4.8 star rating, we have built our reputation on clear communication, trust, and professional standards.



We are not looking for a “virtual assistant”.

We are looking for the engine room of our front-of-house operations — someone to execute our systems, master our checklists, and grow into a senior operations role over time.



The Role



You will act as our remote Service Advisor, bridging the gap between the workshop and the customer. You will control job progression, provide technical explanations, and maintain administrative accuracy across every job.



This role requires a deep technical understanding of vehicles.



Ideally, you are a former mechanic or technician who understands how workshop time, diagnostics, and repairs really work, and now wants to work in a structured, remote, operations-focused role.



You must be able to communicate at the level of a main-dealer service advisor — calm, confident, and professional, even when explaining complex repairs, estimates, or delays.



You will be trained using step-by-step Loom videos, SOPs, and checklists — and expected to improve these systems over time.



Key Responsibilities

Customer Logistics

Answer inbound calls, WhatsApp messages, and emails. Book MOTs, services, and diagnostics with precision.



Workshop Control

Create jobs in Motasoft, allocate labour hours correctly, and track progress using Autodata and Haynes Pro.



Estimating & Approvals

Prepare clear, technical estimates. Proactively follow up for authorisation efficiently and proffessionally.



Proactive Management

Flag parts delays or over-running jobs early. Ensure no “loose ends” in digital paperwork.



System Improvement

Use our Loom SOPs and checklists, while actively finding ways to reduce errors and inefficiencies.





The Perfect Candidate



Technical DNA

You understand how a car works and how a workshop flows. You are comfortable using Goggle Workspace and technical platforms to support your decisions.



Communication Pro

Your English is excellent. You can explain a head gasket failure or timing belt interval in a way that builds complete customer trust.



Main Dealer Standards

You likely have experience with brands such as: BMW, VAG, Land Rover, Ford, Mercedez



Methodical Mindset

You enjoy structure. You don’t miss details. You notice when things don’t add up. You take ownership of outcomes.



Role Details

description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized Labor Compliance Specialist / Auditor to support the review, auditing, and administration of labor compliance requirements for public works, federally funded, and other regulated construction projects. The ideal candidate must be able to follow instructions carefully, adhere to established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain accurate and orderly documentation, and consistently complete detailed processes without skipping required steps.



This is not strictly an administrative compliance position. We are specifically seeking a candidate with a strong auditing and accounting background who is comfortable reviewing payroll records, reconciling financial information, identifying discrepancies, documenting findings, and conducting detailed compliance reviews.



The ideal candidate understands how financial records connect and has experience in auditing, accounting, payroll, or financial reconciliation. Prior labor compliance or construction experience is highly preferred but may not be required for an exceptional accounting/audit candidate who can learn regulatory requirements quickly.



A CPA, CPA candidate, or candidate with formal accounting/auditing credentials is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities:



Labor Compliance & Auditing



Conduct detailed audits of contractor and subcontractor labor compliance documentation.

Review Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Compare payroll records against supporting documentation to identify inconsistencies or potential violations.

Audit employee classifications, wage rates, fringe benefits, hours worked, overtime, deductions, and payroll calculations.

Identify underpayments, overpayments, missing documentation, discrepancies, and other compliance deficiencies.

Review payroll registers, timecards, proof of payment, canceled checks, direct-deposit records, invoices, and other supporting financial documentation.

Calculate potential wage restitution and document the basis for audit findings.

Maintain detailed audit trails and supporting documentation.

Prepare clear audit findings, deficiency notices, and compliance correspondence.

Follow up with contractors and subcontractors regarding outstanding deficiencies and corrective actions.

Assist with internal and external compliance audits and investigation

Verify calculations independently rather than relying solely on information provided by contractors.

Maintain organized records capable of supporting an audit, investigation, or agency review.

Public Works & Prevailing Wage Compliance



Training Will be provided on specific labor compliance regulations and systems for candidates with exceptional accounting and auditing qualifications.



REQUIRED Qualifications



Candidates must have professional experience in auditing, accounting, or financial review, payroll, reconciliations, or similar accounting functions.



We offer a Competitive Salary with Bonuses, Raises, Paid Holidays, Sick Days, Referral Bonuses. 

Several shifts offered (with a one hour lunch break) PST from 4am-1pm, 5am-2pm, 6am-3pm, 7am-4pm, 8am-5pm. Training will be done on the 6am-3pm shifts. Shift availability is based on Seniority.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Custom Sports Apparel Designer — Sublimated Team Wear (Long-Term Contract)
description:
Type of Work: Graphic Design Service Fee: $1,000 – $1,500/month USD, based on experience. Exceptional senior candidates may be considered above this range. Coverage required: You organize your own working time, but must maintain a 2-hour overlap with our US team on our business days, inside our window of 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. US Central Time, for customer communication and handoffs. Company holidays and your own paid days off are excluded. We agree the exact window with you at the start.



About Us

Stitches & Dye, Oh My! is a US-based custom apparel company. We create original designs for bowling leagues, tournaments, and teams. Customers come to us with colors, an idea, and sometimes a reference photo, and we design something original for them. Our third-party vendor handles production.



We produce a full range: bowling jerseys, polos, t-shirts, hoodies, hats, and accessories. Bowling jerseys are our

specialty and the most technically demanding piece.



What You Will Own

• Create original apparel designs from a customer brief

• Present concepts to the customer and run the revision conversation with them directly

• Translate vague feedback ("make it more aggressive," "the logo feels small") into specific design changes

• Prepare print-ready files to our vendor's template and spec

• Submit approved files to the vendor and answer their production questions

• Update the order record after each customer exchange so our E-Commerce, Customer Operations & Social

Media Contractor always knows where the design stands

• On request, supply specialized apparel and product design assets for social media. Routine social content is

owned by that same contractor, not you.



Our service standard: first concept within two of our business days after a complete brief, and each revision within two of our business days after complete customer feedback. The clock does not start until the brief or feedback is complete.



Requirements

Must have:

• Strong Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop skills. Canva alone is not enough.

• Portfolio showing custom apparel or team sportswear. Include jerseys or uniforms if you have them.

• Experience preparing files for sublimation or DTF printing: vector artwork, correct color mode, bleed, seam and

panel placement, roster names and numbers

• Excellent written English. You will email our customers directly.

• Ability to work from a written brief and vendor spec sheet without constant supervision

• Judgment to stop and ask when a brief or a supplied file has a problem

• Computer that runs Adobe software well and reliable internet



Nice to have:

• Bowling, sports team, or league apparel experience

• Product or apparel mockup and presentation experience



What We Provide

• Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, and Shutterstock accounts

• Payment via Wise, twice monthly. The 1st–15th is paid on the 25th; the 16th–end of month is paid on the 10th of the following month. We cover all transfer fees, so you receive the full amount.

• Company-funded Maxicare PRIMA or MediCard Health Plus after 90 days, subject to provider eligibility

• Paid Service Days: first earned at Day 120, then one for each 30 days of service after that

• Paid Non-Service Days on US and Philippine dates, per our published annual calendar

• Annual Service Bonus equal to one month's fee, earned every 12 months of service



This is a long-term, non-exclusive independent contractor engagement. You organize your own working time. For your first month our lead designer reviews every file before it goes to the vendor. After that you gain independence.



How to Apply

Subject line: APPAREL DESIGNER — [Your Name]

Include:

1. Portfolio link with apparel work clearly marked

2. Your experience preparing files for sublimation printing

3. Which Adobe programs you use most and your version

4. Your available overlap hours in US Central Time

5. Answer this: A customer says they want "something with blue and gold, kind of aggressive looking, with an

eagle." What three questions would you ask before you start designing?



Applications without an answer to #5 will not be reviewed.



Finalists receive a paid two-part test project using a real past order.



THE PAID TESTS

Both roles get a paid work-sample test. Portfolios and interviews show the best version of a candidate; a test shows what they do under your constraints. 



Before you send any test materials

Finalists have not signed the contractor agreement, so Sections 5 through 7 do not protect anything you hand them. Two things to do first.



Send a Paid Test Acknowledgment and get a reply agreeing to it:

Test materials provided by Stitches & Dye, Oh My! LLC are confidential and may be used only for this hiring exercise. They may not be posted, shared, added to a portfolio, reused, or distributed, and must be permanently deleted when the hiring process concludes or earlier upon Company's request. Finalist will confirm deletion in writing upon request. Any work product you produce for this test is for evaluation only and will not be commercially used by Stitches & Dye unless separately agreed in writing.



That last sentence protects the finalist as much as you, and saying so removes any ownership argument with someone who never becomes your contractor.



Substitute the identifying artwork. Removing a customer's name does not anonymize the order when their team logo is on the jersey. Replace the real logo with a fictional or Stitches & Dye-owned one. The real brief, the garment, the template problem, and the revision history all still work as a test without the actual customer's identity attached.

Speak clear, confident, natural English on the phone

Have a reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace and a headset

2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: VP of Operations | H&C | Legal Operations & Team Management
description:
Role Hours: 9:00AM-6:00PM EST



H&C is hiring a hands-on VP of Operations to take ownership of daily operations, supervise our remote legal support team, and reduce the founder's involvement in routine task management.



This is a working leadership role in a small legal support business. You will organize work, investigate blockers, review deliverables, coach staff, and follow tasks through to verified completion. Success means the founder receives clear recommendations and work ready for review without having to direct every step.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Turn attorney and client instructions into clear assignments with an owner, source documents, priority, deadline, and expected deliverable.

• Manage daily priorities and workload; supervise, train, and hold remote staff accountable for quality and follow-through.

• Resolve routine questions by reviewing instructions,
 threads, matter records, and existing procedures before escalating.

• Review drafts and filing packets for correct names, case numbers, dates, calculations, attachments, completeness, and consistency with source documents.

• Track document requests, intake, discovery support, filing receipts, calendaring, billing support, and outstanding approvals.

• Distinguish drafted, approved, submitted, accepted, and completed work. Verify completion in the relevant source system.

• Build and improve practical SOPs, checklists, and handoff procedures. Preserve established
 templates and the founder's communication style.

• Keep each client firm's records, accounts, communications, and workflows separate and confidential.

• Provide one concise daily operations summary covering completed work, approaching deadlines, unresolved blockers, and decisions needed. Escalate urgent issues promptly.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING

• Demonstrated experience leading remote staff and owning operations in a law firm or legal support environment.

• Strong legal administrative workflow knowledge and the ability to review support work against source records. This role does not require you to be a U.S. attorney.

• Specific examples of assigning work, correcting errors, coaching staff, and improving a process without constant owner involvement.

• Excellent written and spoken English, sound judgment, careful attention to detail, and reliable follow-through.

• Experience with task management, document management,
, spreadsheets, and legal practice software. Clio, Smokeball, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and U.S. litigation or family-law support experience are valuable.

• Reliable internet, a suitable remote workspace, and consistent overlap with U.S. Central business hours.



AUTHORITY AND JUDGMENT

You will own routine operational decisions within agreed procedures. Substantive legal decisions remain with the supervising attorney. External communications, filings, billing changes, and other final actions must follow the specific approvals established for each client. When a decision is needed, bring the issue, what you checked, your recommended next step, and a prepared draft when applicable.



FIRST 30 DAYS

Learn the existing workflows, take over daily team coordination, establish reliable task and approval tracking, resolve recurring operational blockers, and demonstrate that work can move forward with substantially less routine input from the founder.



HOW TO APPLY

Begin your application with OPERATIONS and answer these questions:

1. What legal operations and remote team leadership experience do you have? How many people did you directly supervise, and what were you accountable for?

2. Describe a process you took over from a founder or attorney. What changed, and how did you measure the result?

3. Give a specific example of reviewing and correcting an employee's work. How did you prevent the error from recurring?

4. An assistant says a document is missing and a task is due today. What would you investigate and do before contacting the founder?

5. What are your current work commitments, availability during U.S. Central business hours, and earliest start date?

6. What is your desired hourly or monthly rate in USD?



Include your resume and, if available, a redacted SOP, task tracker, or quality checklist you created. Do not include confidential client information. Shortlisted applicants will complete an interview and a practical exercise using fictional information.

title: Operations & Administrative Coordinator
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



We are a growing transportation company looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and dependable Operations & Administrative Coordinator to become an important part of our team.



This is NOT a dispatcher position. You do not need previous trucking or logistics experience.



We are a small but growing company, so this position may not fit neatly into one traditional job title. We need someone who is comfortable wearing different hats, learning our processes, helping us improve them, and making sure important tasks don't fall through the cracks.



What We Really Need



We're looking for someone who naturally thinks:



"What needs to happen next?"



You will work closely with approximately three members of our management team. Your role is to help keep everyone organized, track outstanding tasks, follow up, communicate, and help move things from requested → in progress → completed.



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions all day.



We want someone who can learn how our company operates and eventually recognize what needs to happen next without being reminded.



For example:



If we tell you a new driver is starting, over time you should learn the onboarding process and know that certain documents, agreements, manuals, information, and follow-ups need to be completed.



If someone says a driver needs a flight, we want you to help research the options, communicate with the appropriate people, and follow the task through until the travel arrangements are resolved.



If an important task has been sitting open, we want you to notice it and follow up.



Responsibilities May Include



Keeping management organized and tracking outstanding tasks



Following up with team members to ensure important items are completed



Assisting with new-driver onboarding and administrative requirements



Sending and tracking contracts, manuals, forms, and other documents



Following established company processes and checklists



Helping create or improve processes when needed



Coordinating travel, including researching flights, hotels, and transportation



Researching repair shops, service providers, vendors, and other resources



Calling businesses or vendors to obtain information when necessary



Communicating with drivers and management by phone, text, and



Tracking time-off requests and other driver needs



Maintaining organized records, trackers, and task lists



Following up on incomplete or unanswered requests



Identifying potential problems before they become bigger problems



Helping management with administrative and operational projects as the company grows



The Person We're Looking For



You are extremely organized.



You like lists, processes, checklists, calendars, reminders, and completed tasks.



You are also forward-thinking. If something is scheduled for Friday, you don't wait until Friday to realize something needed to happen on Wednesday.



You communicate.



You follow up.



You ask questions when necessary.



You aren't afraid to pick up the phone.



And when you're given something you've never done before, your first response isn't:



"I don't know how to do that."



It's:



"Let me figure it out."



You should be comfortable using Google, ChatGPT/AI tools, spreadsheets, online booking platforms,
, text messaging, and other basic business tools to find information and solve problems.



Reliability Is Extremely Important



Because you will be helping coordinate real people and real operational needs, we need someone we can depend on.



If you say you're going to complete something, we expect it to be completed—or for you to communicate with us before it becomes a problem.



We don't expect perfection.



We do expect communication, ownership, organization, and follow-through.



Schedule & Availability



This is not a traditional 9-to-5 position.



Some days may be busy. Other days may have very little operational activity.



The position will include scheduled daily checkpoints to review outstanding tasks and follow-ups, along with an agreed coverage period for certain time-sensitive requests.



You will not be expected to sit at a computer continuously waiting for work.



However, because transportation operates outside traditional business hours, some flexibility is important.



The exact schedule, checkpoints, availability expectations, and compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates.



Growth Opportunity



We want someone who is looking for more than a temporary freelance project.



Our company is growing, and this role has the opportunity to grow with it.



As you learn our company, our drivers, our processes, and how we operate, we want you to become someone our management team can trust with increasing responsibility.



That may eventually mean helping manage systems, improving workflows, taking ownership of certain administrative functions, training others, or growing into a larger operations/office-management role.



We don't expect you to know our business on Day 1.



We do expect you to be eager to learn it.

title: Property Manager
description:
Property Manager 

Job Description



Reports to:

Senior PM

Division:

GOPM

Department:

Property Management

Status:

Full-Time

Location and Work Setup:

Remote



Summary:

Green Ocean Property Management (GOPM) is hiring a detail-driven and proactive Property Manager Assistant to support the daily operations of our property management team. In this role, you will be instrumental in maintaining tenant satisfaction, ensuring smooth leasing processes, and coordinating with vendors and internal teams to address property needs.



This is a client-facing, systems-heavy role that requires strong organization, responsiveness, and communication skills. You’ll handle the front lines of tenant communication, assist with maintenance logistics, and contribute to streamlined operational execution — all from a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Tenant Communication & Lease Management

Act as the primary point of contact for tenants — address inquiries, requests, and concerns in a timely, professional manner.

Assist in lease lifecycle management including drafting lease agreements, facilitating renewals, and processing terminations.

Manage rent collection activities, send reminders, escalate late payments, and help enforce payment terms.



Maintenance Coordination

Serve as liaison between tenants, property owners, and vendors.

Schedule and monitor maintenance and repair work orders using internal tracking tools.

Ensure follow-through and resolution of service requests; maintain a high standard of property condition.



Records Management

Maintain up-to-date digital records including leases, inspection reports, rent rolls, and maintenance logs.

Ensure compliance with state and federal property management regulations regarding documentation and tenant interactions.



Tenant Screening & Onboarding

Conduct background checks, verify employment and references for prospective tenants.

Assist in preparing onboarding materials and move-in documentation.



Move-In/Move-Out Support

Assist in the coordination of property inspections for both move-ins and move-outs.

Prepare condition reports and coordinate with vendors for turnover services.

Ensure timely processing of security deposit returns in accordance with regulations.



Reporting & Data Entry

Generate regular operational reports, including:

Occupancy/vacancy rates

Maintenance activity summaries

Rent collection status

Lease expiration schedules

Flag operational risks or trends proactively.



Marketing & Listings Support

Create or update rental listings on platforms such as Zillow,
 Marketplace, and RentRedi.

Coordinate with the leasing team to schedule virtual or in-person property showings.

Monitor listing performance and suggest optimizations.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with the property management, leasing, and accounting teams to ensure efficient workflow.

Escalate urgent issues while maintaining alignment with internal processes and SOPs.

Suggest process improvements that enhance tenant experience or team productivity.



Qualifications:

Minimum 2 years experience in property management, real estate operations, or virtual property assistance.

Knowledge of lease administration, rental laws, and maintenance coordination processes.

Ability to multitask across a high volume of properties or tenants.

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and professional customer service demeanor.





Technical Proficiency

Strong experience with property management software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, RentRedi, or similar).

Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar) and Microsoft Office.

Comfortable using remote tools like Slack, Zoom, and project management boards (Asana, Trello).

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: HOA Finance Assistant -Remote
description:
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Reporting Line:

Day-to-day: Bookholders ? Assistant Finance Manager

Cash Flow, Compliance, Coordination: Bookholders ? Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight (Reports to Asst FM)

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM)

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management (Reports to Asst FM)

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.



6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM)

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM)

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Ability to take initiative to identify, prioritize and implement all elements required for the team to fulfill responsibilities

Ability to work well under pressure and effectively handle multiple, concurrent demands and appropriately prioritize responsibilities

Property Management experience is a must

Quickbooks experience a plus

title: B2B Appointment Setter / SDR – Warm Leads
description:
Appointment Setter / SDR – $750/Month + Performance Bonuses



Apply Here



To be considered, complete our short application form:





You will be asked to upload a 60–90 second introduction video explaining your experience and why you are suitable for the role.



Applications without a completed Typeform and introduction video will not be considered.



About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, confident and highly organised Appointment Setter / SDR to join our team long-term.

We operate a B2B client-acquisition company working with established professional-service businesses, primarily Accounting and Tax firms in the United States.



Our outbound campaigns generate interested prospects. Your job is not to hard-sell accounting services.



Your job is to contact interested prospects, qualify them, book them onto our clients’ calendars, confirm their appointments and help ensure they attend.



Compensation



$750 USD per month base salary



Plus:



$3 USD for every qualified appointment that shows up



Bonuses are based on attended appointments—not simply appointments booked.



There is room for increased compensation and responsibility for strong performers.



Your Responsibilities



You will manage prospects from the moment they express interest until they attend an appointment.



This includes:



Calling new leads as quickly as possible

Following up by phone,
 and SMS

Contacting interested prospects who have not booked

Asking basic qualification questions

Booking suitable prospects onto client calendars

Calling direct bookings to confirm and qualify them

Reconfirming upcoming appointments

Following up with no-shows

Rescheduling missed appointments

Following up with older opportunities

Updating CRM stages and notes

Keeping client calendars organised

Informing clients which appointments are confirmed

Following our scripts, SOPs and follow-up processes



Your goal is simple:



The client should only need to open Zoom and speak with a qualified prospect who is prepared for the conversation.



What You Are Not Doing



You are not expected to:



Close the final sale

Give detailed accounting or tax advice

Pressure prospects into purchasing

Make completely unqualified calls all day

Your job is to sell the meeting, not the service.



You should be able to explain why the consultation may be worthwhile, answer basic questions, qualify the prospect and move them toward an appointment.



Typical Workflow



When a new interested prospect enters the CRM:

You receive a notification.

You check whether they have already booked.

If they have not booked, you contact them quickly.

You ask the required qualification questions.

If suitable, you book them onto the client’s calendar.

You add clear notes and update the CRM.

You reconfirm the appointment before the meeting.

If they do not attend, you follow up and reschedule them.

You continue following up according to our SOP.



You will regularly review the CRM for:



New leads

Leads requiring follow-up

Unbooked prospects

Upcoming appointments

Unconfirmed appointments

No-shows

Rescheduling opportunities



Requirements



You must have:



Excellent spoken English

Clear and easy-to-understand pronunciation

Strong conversational skills

Confidence speaking with American business owners

Appointment-setting, SDR, call-centre, sales or customer-service experience

Strong written English

Good organisation and attention to detail

Reliable high-speed internet

A reliable computer and headset

A quiet working environment

The ability to follow scripts and SOPs

The ability to maintain accurate CRM records

The ability to work independently



You do not need to imitate an American accent. However, your English must be clear, natural and professional.



Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is beneficial:

B2B appointment setting

SDR work

Cold calling

Warm or inbound lead follow-up

High-ticket appointment setting

Accounting or financial services

GoHighLevel

Smartlead

Slack

Calendly

Google Calendar

CRM management

US-based clients



Training will be provided on our systems and processes.



Working Hours



You will primarily contact prospects in the United States, so you must be comfortable working hours that overlap with US business hours.



For applicants in the Philippines, this will generally require evening or overnight work.



Your exact schedule may change depending on the clients assigned to you.



We care heavily about speed to lead. New prospects should be contacted quickly during your working hours.



How Performance Is Measured - Your performance will be measured using:



Speed to lead

Contact rate

Lead-to-appointment booking rate

Appointment confirmation rate

Show rate

Qualified attended appointments

Follow-up consistency

CRM accuracy

Call quality



We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls.



We want someone who takes ownership of the pipeline and thinks:



“How do I move as many suitable prospects as possible from interested lead, to booked appointment, to attended appointment?”



Training Provided - You will receive training covering:



Our appointment-setting process

Our clients’ services and offers

Basic Accounting and Tax terminology

Qualification questions

Common prospect questions

Appointment booking

CRM management

Direct bookings

Appointment confirmations

No-show recovery

Rescheduling

Long-term pipeline follow-up

Scripts and objection handling



You will receive clear SOPs and ongoing feedback.



Who We Want - We want someone who is:



Reliable

Confident on the phone

Friendly and professional

Coachable
