title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Recruiter
description:
Position Summary

The Recruitment Coordinator calls every applicant YESA receives online, qualifies them on the phone, and books the ones who pass into a recruiter's calendar. The measure of the role is booked interviews that show up — not dials logged.

This is a high-volume phone role. Applicant flow for door-to-door field sales is heavy and low-intent: most people who apply will not answer, and most who answer will not qualify. The Coordinator works that volume fast and without losing tone on the fortieth call of the day, so that recruiters spend their time interviewing qualified people instead of chasing unqualified ones.

Speed is the job's main lever. An applicant contacted within five minutes converts several times better than one contacted the next day, and YESA competes for the same candidates as every other field sales employer in the market. The Coordinator owns that response window.



This is a fully remote role, hired internationally, working North American business hours for the assigned market. The Coordinator reports to the Recruiter or Recruitment Manager for that market, and is the first human contact a candidate has with YESA — how that call sounds is how the company is judged.



What Success Looks Like

By 30 days — Trained on the YESA screen criteria, ATS and calendar process. Working the inbound queue independently. Hitting call volume, booking at roughly 70% of target.

By 60 days — Full booking target met weekly. Show rate above 60%. Working aged applicants and re-engagement lists, not just today's inbound.

By 90 days — Program complete, rate steps up. Consistently at target on booked-and-showed. Booked candidates converting to starts at a rate recruiters trust.

Key Performance Indicators

The Coordinator is measured on booked interviews that show, not on activity. Dial and contact volume are inputs the manager watches for coaching; they are not the target.

• Dials — 120–150 per day, 600–750 per week. Outbound call attempts to applicants.

• Live connects — 25–35 per day, 125–175 per week. Applicant answered and held a conversation.

• Qualified — 15–20 per day, 75–100 per week. Passed the screen criteria on the phone.

• Interviews booked — 12–15 per day, 60–75 per week. Confirmed slot in a recruiter's calendar.

• Booked and showed — 8–10 per day, 40–50 per week. Candidate attended. This is the primary target.

• Show rate — 65% or higher. Showed divided by booked.

• Speed to lead — 15 minutes or less, median, from application to first dial.

—

Weekly targets are set to feed one recruiter running at full capacity: 40–50 completed interviews per week is the recruiter's own target, and it only holds if the Coordinator is booking 60–75 to get there.

Two quality checks sit behind the volume. Downstream start rate — what share of showed candidates the recruiter takes to a signed offer — catches a Coordinator who is booking anyone to hit a number. Qualification accuracy — candidates who reach interview and fail on travel or direct sales experience, both of which should have been caught on the phone — is reviewed weekly with the recruiter and should sit under 10%.



Core Responsibilities

Applicant response

• Work the inbound applicant queue continuously through the day; call every new applicant within 15 minutes during business hours

• Run a persistent contact sequence — multiple call attempts across different times of day, plus text and
 — before marking an applicant unreachable

• Work aged and previously unreachable applicants on a set cadence; a candidate who did not answer in March may answer in May

Phone qualification

• Run the YESA phone screen on every live connect: right to work, travel and schedule availability, transportation, compensation expectations, and genuine interest in field sales

• Give an honest description of the work — doors, weather, rejection, commission — before booking. A candidate who books without understanding the job becomes a no-show or a week-three quit

• Disqualify clearly and respectfully when someone does not fit, and record why

Booking and show rate

• Book qualified candidates directly into the assigned recruiter's calendar, matching market and interview type

• Confirm every booking the same day and again the day before, by the channel the candidate actually responds on

• Rebook no-shows once; track no-show reasons and feed the patterns back to the recruiter

Pipeline and handoff

• Keep the ATS current in real time — dispositions, notes, and screen answers recorded during the call, not at the end of the day

• Write a short handoff note for every booked candidate so the recruiter opens the interview already knowing the basics

• Flag standout candidates immediately rather than letting them sit in a queue

Support

• Support hiring events and job fairs with pre-event confirmation calling and post-event follow-up

• Post and refresh job ads across boards as directed



Requirements

Must have

• Phone-based sales, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound experience. They have carried a daily call and booking target and can say what their numbers were. Recruitment experience is not required; phone stamina is

• Clear, easily understood spoken English. A North American applicant should be able to follow the call without effort. This is the single most common reason offshore coordinators fail in this role

• Experience calling into North American markets, or clear evidence they can handle the pace and idiom of those conversations

• Comfort making 120+ dials a day, indefinitely, with the same energy on the last call as the first

• Ability to hold a structured conversation and disqualify without being rude — warm on the phone, firm on the criteria

• Organized in a system: manages a live queue, records accurately as they go, does not lose people

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a working headset, and a contingency for power or internet outages. Verified before hire, not assumed

• Available to work North American business hours for the assigned market, including some evenings and occasional Saturdays — that is when field sales applicants answer

• Able to be engaged as an independent contractor in their country of residence

Strongly preferred

• Experience calling into a cold or low-intent applicant or lead list, rather than warm inbound only

• Background in door-to-door, telecom, solar, alarm, or another commission-only field sales environment — they can describe the job credibly because they have lived it

• ATS or CRM fluency and comfort managing 200+ active records

• Bilingual English/French for Quebec markets

• Experience in a role where pay was tied to booked-and-showed, not dials



Screen-outs

Confirmed before the candidate reaches a live interview. Cannot sustain the call volume, or wants a role where calling is a portion of the day rather than the whole of it — decline. Cannot describe the field sales job honestly without apologizing for it — decline; the same squeamishness will cost YESA shows and starts.



Compensation

USD $9.00/hour, rising to USD $10.00/hour on completion of the 90-day program. Engaged as an independent contractor, responsible for their own taxes and statutory obligations in their country of residence.

 with the subject line:

title: Outbound Call Center Agent
description:
About Us

We are one of the largest Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa franchise groups in the United States — 16+ spa locations across the country, and still opening more. Hand & Stone is one of America’s leading spa brands, helping hundreds of thousands of clients every year feel better through professional massage, facial, and wellness services.

Behind those spas is a remote outbound team that keeps our appointment books full — and we treat that team like true employees, not freelancers. Many of our agents have been with us for years. We invest in training, celebrate wins loudly, run contests constantly, and promote from within as we grow. When you join us, you’re joining a stable, growing American company that considers you part of the family.

Why You’ll Love This Job

• Guaranteed monthly salary — 42,000–55,000/month depending on experience, paid reliably, on time, every time. No waiting on clients or chasing invoices.

• Uncapped commissions — you earn on every appointment you book. Our top performers take home 85,000–115,000+ per month all-in.

• Warm leads only — every person you call has already asked about our services. No cold calling, no hostile hang-ups — just friendly conversations with people who want to book.

• Permanent work from home — a long-term, full-time career, not a short gig. Skip the commute and build your future from home.

• Contests, bonuses & recognition — regular contests and incentives that keep the work fun and put extra money in your pocket.

• Real career growth — we promote from within. Agents grow into team lead, training, and operations roles as we open new locations.

• Paid training & real support — proven scripts, ongoing coaching, and leadership that wants you to win.

What You’ll Do

• Call and text warm leads who requested information about massages, facials, and spa services — and book them into appointments at our spas

• Follow up with interested prospects until they book, with professionalism, confidence, and empathy

• Educate clients on our services, memberships, and current promotions to build excitement

• Hit daily and weekly booking goals with full support and coaching from leadership

• Log every call outcome accurately in our booking system

What We’re Looking For

• Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, friendly phone voice

• A confident, positive, coachable personality and the drive to meet goals

• Availability to work 40 hours/week during US business hours (night shift, Philippine time)

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace

• Sales, appointment setting, or call center experience is a plus — but attitude matters more



How to Apply

Start your application with the word SERENITY so we know you read this far. Then send us:

• Your resume

• A short note on why you’re a great fit

• A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself (a link is fine — Vocaroo works great)

• A screenshot of your internet speed test from Speedtest.net

We review every complete application and respond quickly. We can’t wait to meet you!

title: PAID ADS SPECIALIST
description:
We are a fast-growing SEO and e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands. We are looking for a Paid Ads Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize high-performing digital advertising campaigns that drive traffic, leads, and revenue growth.



This role is ideal for a performance-driven marketer who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in scaling paid acquisition campaigns across multiple platforms, with strong experience in budget management, audience targeting, keyword research, ad creative testing, A/B testing, and campaign optimization. The role requires continuous monitoring of performance metrics and delivering actionable insights to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency (CPL/ROAS). Develop and execute paid advertising strategies across platforms like Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms and ad compliance



Key Responsibilities:

Plan, launch, and manage paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), and LinkedIn, and develop multi-platform paid strategies, including TikTok and other relevant channels.

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis to improve campaign performance

Develop, test, and optimize ad creatives, copy, and landing page alignment

Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize ROI and reduce acquisition costs

Perform continuous A/B testing on ads, audiences, and campaign structures

Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance metrics (CPC, CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversions)

Identify scaling opportunities and implement data-driven optimization strategies

Collaborate with design and marketing teams to ensure high-performing creatives and messaging.

Leverage hands-on experience with platform algorithms and ad compliance to optimize campaign performance while ensuring strict adherence to advertising policies, platform guidelines, and regulatory standards.



What We’re Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is highly preferred.

title: Executive Assistant / Client Journey Manager – UK Marketing Agency (Claude AI + Slack)
description:
About us



Tutor Easily is a UK-based marketing agency that helps tutors and tuition businesses grow. We build their websites and funnels, edit their video sales letters (VSLs), set up their social media, and run their paid ad campaigns. We work with a large number of clients at once, and every client has their own Slack channel where our team and the client work together.



The role



We're looking for a highly organised Executive Assistant to own the client journey from start to finish. You will be the person who makes sure nothing gets missed. Every client should always know their next step, every task should have an owner, and every approved document should reach the client on time.



You will work closely with our founders, account managers, video editors, web team and media buyers. You won't be doing the creative work yourself. Your job is to make sure the work moves forward.



A big part of this role is using Claude (AI assistant) every day. You'll use it to review our Slack channels, see where each client is in their journey, flag anything stuck or overdue, and prepare and send documents to clients once they've been approved. We'll train you on our setup, but you need to be comfortable working with AI tools and learning fast.



What you'll do



Use Claude every day to scan client Slack channels and produce a daily status report showing what's moving, what's stuck, which client questions haven't been answered, and which tasks are overdue.

Own every client's journey through our phases: onboarding and account access, website/funnel build, VSL editing and revisions, social media setup, and ad campaign launch.

Follow up with clients who are waiting on us, and chase clients we're waiting on (e.g. raw VSL footage, scripts, account access, feedback on edits) in a friendly, professional way.

Make sure every task has a clear owner on our team, and follow up internally until it's done.

Send documents to clients once they have been approved internally, such as onboarding checklists, edited VSLs, strategy documents, and feedback notes. Nothing goes out without approval.

Keep our Google Sheets trackers accurate and up to date.

Make sure client feedback (e.g. VSL revision notes) is clearly passed to the right team member and actioned.

Spot patterns, like clients who seem confused about next steps or go quiet, and raise them before they become problems.

Support the founders with inbox, calendar and general admin tasks as needed.



What we're looking for



At least 2 years' experience as an EA, VA or project/account coordinator at a marketing agency. This is a must. You should understand how agencies work with many clients at once.

Excellent written English. Our clients are UK-based, so you'll need to use UK spelling (e.g. "programme", "optimise") and a warm, professional tone.

Very strong Slack skills. You're comfortable managing many channels, threads and mentions without losing track.

Experience using Claude or ChatGPT for real work tasks, not just casual use. Claude experience is a strong plus.

Comfortable with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets).

Highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented. You follow up without being asked.

Reliable internet, a backup power source, and a quiet place to work.

Available to work UK hours.



Nice to have



Experience supporting paid ads, video editing or social media teams



How to apply



Please send:



Your CV

A short Loom video (max 3 minutes) introducing yourself and describing a time you kept many client projects on track at once

One example of how you've used Claude or ChatGPT to save time in a previous job



Start your application with the words "Client Journey Owner" so we know you've read this post in full. Applications without this will not be considered.

, LinkedIn, Instagram, websites, advertising, and other digital channels.

title: FACEBOOK ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATION/EDITING
description:
We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time role (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

We are a fast-moving, customer-focused company that values responsiveness, resourcefulness, attention to detail, and taking ownership of the work.



Position Overview



Broadwire Networks is looking for a full-time Technical Dispatch Coordinator to manage field service dispatches from initial request through final closeout.



This is a hands-on technical coordination role where you will manage technician scheduling, onsite activity, customer communication, troubleshooting, documentation, and job closeout.



Our dispatches vary significantly, which keeps the work interesting. One day you may be coordinating a network or wireless site survey. Another may involve the installation of an eFemto cellular solution, Starlink equipment, an outdoor cellular router and antenna system, structured cabling, network equipment, or other smart hands services.



You will work directly with field technicians throughout the country to help make sure they understand the scope, arrive prepared, stay within the expected level of effort, provide timely updates, and properly document their work.



We are looking for someone who is technical, organized, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple active jobs at the same time. Prior hands-on field experience in telecom, low-voltage cabling, networking, wireless, or a similar technical environment is strongly preferred.



This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys having ownership of their work and does not need constant direction. We will provide the tools, processes, training, and support needed to succeed, while giving you the independence to work through problems, make decisions, and keep projects moving. We also value someone who knows when to ask questions or escalate an issue when needed.



Own assigned field service dispatches from creation through final closeout

Acknowledge new dispatch requests and maintain timely communication with customers

Create, schedule, and manage technician work orders

Coordinate qualified field technicians for installation, service, and site survey work

Review scopes of work with technicians before scheduled dispatches

Make sure technicians understand the scope, expectations, documentation requirements, and expected level of effort

Confirm technician ETA, arrival, site access, and onsite contacts

Monitor active dispatches and maintain communication with technicians throughout the job

Periodically check in with technicians to confirm progress and identify problems early

Monitor technician time and help keep dispatches within the approved labor budget

Identify potential scope changes or overages before additional time is incurred whenever possible

Provide basic technical guidance and troubleshooting support to field technicians

Coordinate with customers, NOCs, engineering teams, and project managers when additional support is required

Review technician notes, photos, test results, measurements, and other documentation

Make sure required documentation is complete before technicians are released from the site

Maintain accurate and detailed work order notes

Provide customers with timely status, delay, issue, and completion updates

Follow up on outstanding items and keep jobs moving through completion

Help prevent missed requirements, unnecessary return visits, incomplete documentation, and unexpected labor overages

Types of Projects You May Coordinate



Dispatches may include:



Network and wireless site surveys

Structured cabling installations

Cable testing, tracing, toning, and troubleshooting

Wireless access point installations

Router, switch, firewall, and modem installations

Starlink installations

Outdoor cellular routers and antenna systems

eFemto and cellular coverage solutions

Fixed wireless equipment

Smart hands network troubleshooting

You do not need to be an expert in every technology we support. However, you should have enough technical aptitude to understand the work being performed, communicate effectively with field technicians, and recognize when something does not look right.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organized and detail-oriented

Technical and comfortable working with field technicians

Responsive and dependable

Able to manage multiple active dispatches without losing track of details

Comfortable changing priorities as field conditions change

Resourceful and willing to troubleshoot or research an issue

Able to work independently without constant supervision

Strong at following through and closing the loop

Comfortable making decisions within established guidelines

Professional and confident when communicating with customers and technicians

Calm when projects do not go according to plan

Comfortable holding technicians accountable to the scope of work

Able to recognize when an issue needs to be escalated

Comfortable asking questions when additional guidance is needed

Preferred Experience



Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:



Low-voltage or structured cabling

Telecom installation or service

Network installation

Wireless installation

Cellular or fixed wireless installation

Field service

Smart hands support

ISP or cable installation

MSP or technical support

Technical dispatch

Field service coordination

Network operations

Prior field technician or installer experience is a major plus.



This can be an excellent opportunity for an experienced field technician who understands what happens onsite but is interested in moving into a technical operations and coordination role.



Helpful Technical Knowledge



Familiarity with some of the following is helpful:



Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6A cabling

Toning and tracing cables

Network cable testing

Patch panels and network racks

MDF and IDF environments

DMARC and telecommunications rooms

Routers, switches, firewalls, and modems

Wireless access points

Cellular routers and antennas

Starlink equipment

Ethernet and basic networking

PoE

POTS lines and ATAs

Fiber optic cabling

Network equipment replacement and cutovers

Basic connectivity troubleshooting

Reading scopes of work and installation instructions

What Success Looks Like



Within this role, success means:



Technicians are prepared before arriving onsite

Customers receive timely and accurate updates

Active jobs are monitored without management having to request status updates

Potential problems and labor overages are identified early

Technicians receive support when they encounter issues

Required photos, testing, notes, and documentation are collected

Work orders are properly documented and closed out

Problems are followed through until they are resolved

Fewer return visits occur because something was missed

Multiple active dispatches can move forward without details falling through the cracks

Schedule



This is a full-time position.



Our technicians perform work throughout the United States, so there may occasionally be dispatches or customer communication outside of standard East Coast business hours.

title: Director of Finance & People Operations
description:
Green Ocean Property Management is a family-run residential property management company in Boston, Massachusetts. Our family has been in Boston real estate since 1952. We manage 1,000+ condo units, 500+ rental units, and 60+ condominium associations, with 50+ full-time team members across the US and the Philippines. Our clients rate us 4.9 stars on Google.



We're growing, and we're looking for a senior leader to run both our Finance and HR teams.



The Role



You'll report directly to our COO and lead two managers, our Controller and our HR Manager. You'll own the company's financial discipline and its people systems, and make sure both teams deliver accurate, on-time work without needing day-to-day supervision from leadership.



This is NOT a bookkeeping or HR assistant role. It's a manager-of-managers position for someone who has already led finance and HR teams and can turn numbers and people data into clear decisions.



What You'll Do



Finance



Lead the Controller on month-end close, account reconciliations, AR/AP, payroll accounting, and financial reporting

Keep company books (QuickBooks Online) and client/property books (Buildium) clearly separated

Own budgeting, forecasting, a weekly 13-week cash forecast, and monthly variance reviews

Deliver a monthly management report on revenue, margin, expenses, labor, cash, receivables, and risks

Set and enforce internal controls, approval limits, and reconciliation standards

Improve finance dashboards, data quality, and automation

HR & People Operations



Lead the HR Manager and hold the HR team accountable for recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, retention, and offboarding

Build a workforce plan covering the roles we need, hiring priorities, and compensation cost

Make sure hiring uses role scorecards, structured interviews, and clear pipeline reporting

Track and improve time-to-fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, turnover, and review completion

Build compensation ranges, promotion criteria, and career paths

Leadership



Serve as the COO's right hand for finance and HR operations

Turn financial and people data into a short action list with owners and deadlines

Spot problems early and come with a recommendation, not just the problem

Protect confidential employee, payroll, client, and financial information

Requirements



Several years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including month-end close, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and internal controls

Proven experience managing managers (not just individual staff)

Working knowledge of HR operations: recruitment, performance management, payroll and benefits coordination, and employee relations

Experience with US-based companies and US accounting standards

Experience in property management, real estate, or a multi-entity business is a big plus

Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills

Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable holding managers accountable, respectfully and directly

Available to work US Eastern Time business hours

Reliable internet connection, a laptop/PC, and a working headset and camera

Preferred



CPA, CMA, MBA, or HR certification

Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, Buildium, BambooHR, Google Workspace, Asana, or Slack

Experience improving close speed, cash forecasting, collections, or employee retention, with numbers to show for it

What We Offer



$[X,XXX] – $[X,XXX] USD per month

[Benefits: TBD, e.g. paid time off, HMO allowance, paid holidays]

Long-term, stable full-time role with a well-established US company

A true leadership seat reporting directly to the COO

Work from home

How to Apply

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Finance Assistant/Bookholder
description:
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Reporting Line:

Cash Flow, Compliance, Coordination: Bookholders ? Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight (Reports to Asst FM) 

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM)

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight) 

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM) 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM) 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Real Estate experience a plus

Quickbooks experience a plus

mbers are updating the same QuickBooks or Excel file?

title: Entry-Level US Tax Preparer (ProConnect)
description:
We are a full-service bookkeeping, accounting, tax, and CFO advisory services firm that is operated almost exclusively by our amazing team in the Philippines. Our focus is on optimizing how our clients use QuickBooks Online (QBO) so we can provide them with financial analytics and dashboards on a recurring basis to help their businesses thrive. Our firm is experiencing much more demand than we can handle, so we need to hire more bookkeepers to manage the onboarding, QBO cleanup, and daily bookkeeping needs of our clients.



Company Culture and Benefits:



We are a vibrant and supportive company. When you speak with our staff in the Philippines, you’ll find that we treat our team with respect and genuinely care for each member. Unlike many other firms, we recognize and value our international team members as client-facing experts. Your insights and contributions are not only welcomed but are essential to our growth and success.



We want someone who is fun to work with, has a positive attitude, is caring and kind to others in our team, is highly self-directed, highly organized, and has a very high standard for themselves. We also want someone who is willing to receive feedback and looking to continually improve so they can be a part of our team in 5 years, 10 years and even longer term.

What sets Simple Financials apart is our commitment to our team’s well-being and professional development. You are more important than the client; if a client disrespects you, we will prioritize your well-being over their business. Our culture is built on mutual respect, flexibility, and a genuine interest in helping each team member achieve their personal and professional goals. We listen to your feedback and work together to create a supportive and enriching work environment.



We are looking for a ProConnect Tax Preparer to start immediately. The candidate will help prepare personal and business returns in ProConnect. 



The ideal candidate will have some experience in Intuit ProConnect tax software, and experience preapring US tax returns.



Your input, your contributions and your decisions will be extremely important to the success of our company. With that in mind, we want someone who has experience in a growing team, is fun to work with, has a positive attitude, is caring and kind to others on our team, is highly self-directed, highly organized, highly responsive and has a very high standard for herself/himself. It’s important that this person is someone who thrives on receiving feedback and looking to continually improve so they can be a part of our team over the next 5 years to 10 years or more.



This role is full-time and requires the candidate to work exclusively for our firm. The ideal candidate for this position must be able to work some of their hours in the US Central Standard Time Zone (CST) to meet with clients and our team, while their other hours can be worked whenever they wish.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE MOST OF THE FOLLOWING EXPERIENCE:



Some experience with preparing personal Federal and State Income Tax Returns with Form 1040, Schedule A, Schedule B, Schedule D, Schedule 8812, and other relevant tax forms



Some experience with preparing and filing business Federal and State Income Tax Returns with Form 1120-S, 1120, Schedules C, Form 4562, Form 8829, and other relevant tax forms



Some experience with Intuit ProConnect tax software to prepare and e-file both Personal and Business tax returns at the Federal and State level



Experience that is not requred but would only benefit the candidate: 



 - Experience estimating and filing quarterly taxes owed for business owners

 - Experience with tax laws and regulations applicable to the U.S.-based clients

 - Experience in client-facing roles, providing tax advice and financial planning

 - Experience with State sales tax preparation and filing



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING CHARACTERISTICS:



Highly organized, able to maintain meticulous client records

Highly self-directed, able to manage diverse tasks effectively with being checked in on by others

Strong analytical skills for meticulous and precise work

Strong communication skills both written and verbal

A positive, team-oriented attitude; someone who is fun and caring towards team members

Open to feedback and committed to continuous personal and professional development

Collaborative attitude to effectively work with team members to integrate our current financial services and meet client needs comprehensively

Research focused to stay updated on new tax laws and accounting practices to enhance service quality and operational efficiency

Enjoy handling client inquiries, providing timely and clear responses and support

Available to work during the US Central Standard Time Zone as needed



COMPENSATION:



- $7 per hour - first three months / onboarding period

- $8 to $10 per hour - 4th to 12th month / working under the current management to advance in their role (more time if needed)

- $11-$15 per hour - after a year

- OFS PhilHealth and SSS self-payment reimbursement monthly

- annual promotion with raises to follow depending on your level of success in the position

- Pay periods - 5th and 20th of each month



• Advancement, Growth, and Leadership: As we acquire more companies, you will have long-term growth potential for advanced roles and learning. Over the next 3-5 years, the successful applicant would progress in their role with more strategically-focused responsibilities and potentially manage a team of bookkeepers at higher compensation ranging from $30,000 USD (1.7M Philippine pesos) to $40,000 USD (2.25M Philippine pesos) or more annually.



BENEFITS



• Flexible Work Schedule: During your first three months of Onboarding and Training, it is suggested you come in during CST work hours to maximize your exposure to our company culture and get the training you need to perform at and above expectations. After successfully completing your Onboarding and Training phase, other than the team and client meetings scheduled in CST, you're free to work during your preferred hours.



• Health Insurance Reimbursement: We will reimburse part of your monthly PhilHealth and Social Security System payments for $30 monthly.



• Paid Time Off (PTO): You will start earning vacation leave credits the day you start working at Simple Financials. These leave credits accrue with worked hours, and by working 40 hours per week for the entire year, you will earn:

- 15 days of vacation leave credits per year for the first two years

- 18 days of vacation leave credits per year during your years 3 and 4

- 21 days of vacation leave credits per year after 5 years of tenure

- Unused vacation leaves will be paid out as cash the following year. The actual payout date will be announced separately.



• Paid Holidays: Simple Financials observes specific US holidays. On these days, you will get holiday pay equal to your regular number of hours per day:

• Independence Day (July 4),

• Thanksgiving Day (every 4th Thursday in November),

• Christmas Eve (December 24),

• Christmas Day (December 25),

• New Year’s Day (January 01), and

• New Year’s Eve (December 31)

• Easter Monday (Monday after Easter Sunday)



• Profit Sharing Program: Recently, we have introduced a profit-sharing program for all eligible staff members once they have completed the training and onboarding period. Candidates may also be eligible for profit sharing after 1 year of working with us.



• Company Retreats: To foster employee engagement, we organize in-person retreats or outings that also strengthen camaraderie among our team members. These usally occur two to three times per year.



• Ad Hoc Bonuses: Periodically, we give bonuses for personal milestones such as Mother’s Day, Birthday, Christmas, etc.



TO APPLY:



To Apply, please click the following link - 



Here, you will be prompted to upload a resume, fill out some questionnaire, and finally take a quick assessment. If you pass this first round, we will send you a few follow up assessments.



The last round will involve sending in a video recording of yourself answering a handful of questions, then finally a live face-to-face interview with some of my other team members in the Philippines and an interview with me. Then we will make our final decision.



Please Note: It is best to have already taken your English Proficiency Assessment on your Onlinejobs.ph profile through 
 and the IQ Test through 
 before applying since we will request both of these in the application process. It is not mandatory to have them completed but it will improve your chances of moving along in the process.



SIMPLE FINANCIALS - CORE VALUES



We prioritize precision

Own The Outcome

Engage with Autheticity

We elevate financial clarity

Go above and beyond

title: Tax Operations Associate
description:
DiLucci CPA Firm - Tax Operations Associate



Compensation: $6/hour (USD)

Schedule: Full-Time: 40+ hours per week (9am - 6pm US CST)

During tax season, additional hours and weekend availability will be required as needed to meet client and firm deadlines.

Location: Remote - Philippines



Role Overview

If you enjoy creating efficient systems, keeping projects moving, and ensuring every tax engagement is delivered accurately and on time, our Tax Operations Associate role is for you.



We want to be very transparent - we are the place people go to grow, not to relax. We work more, we work on harder returns, and we enjoy it. If you're not ready to work evenings and weekends during tax season, and to also focus on quality/learning throughout the year, you will hate it here.



DiLucci CPA Firm has been serving business owners and real estate investors since 2005. For nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for doing tax differently—by going deeper than compliance, telling clients the truth, and using the tax code strategically to protect and grow their wealth. Our mission is simple: help clients keep more of what they earn while giving them clarity, confidence, and a long-term plan. We value enjoying what we do (what we call Fun Tax Energy), moving with speed, and operating independently with a focus on the outcome.



As our Tax Operations Associate, you will support the day-to-day operations of the tax team by staying client focused on follow up regarding tax and accounting open items. You'll play a key role in creating operational excellence while allowing our tax professionals to focus on delivering exceptional client service.



This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented role for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities

1. Open Items Follow Up

- Review open-item requests prepared by the tax or accounting team.

- Confirm that requested documents or information are actually missing before contacting the client.

- Contact clients regarding outstanding documents, unanswered questions, signatures, approvals, and other required action items.

- Follow up consistently until each item is resolved.

- Track every request, response, follow-up date, and current status in the firm’s systems.

- Escalate unresponsive clients or time-sensitive issues before they affect deadlines.

- Avoid requesting documents or information that the client has already provided.

2. Client Communication

- Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding outstanding items.

- Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and when it is due.

- Send concise, professional, and easy-to-understand follow-up messages.

- Respond promptly to client questions related to document requests and next steps.

- Maintain a helpful but persistent approach when multiple follow-ups are required.

- Ensure clients always understand their remaining responsibilities.

3. Document Review and Organization

- Review submitted documents to confirm that the requested item was received.

- Identify incomplete, unreadable, incorrect, or missing documents.

Requirements

- Required: Previous experience supporting U.S. tax preparation or tax operations in a CPA firm or tax practice

title: Experienced California Chiropractic Medical Biller – Tebra/Kareo Experience Preferred
description:
We are an established massage spa in California with 17 years of experience, now expanding into chiropractic services and insurance billing. We are seeking an experienced medical biller with specific knowledge of chiropractic billing in California. Experience with Tebra is strongly preferred.



This position may be structured as full-time, part-time, or billing-only/as-needed, depending on the candidate’s availability, experience, and preferred arrangement.



For a part-time or as-needed arrangement, you will handle chiropractic medical billing and insurance-related tasks whenever services are needed. The scope and frequency of the work will depend on the needs of the business and the arrangement agreed upon with the selected candidate.



For a full-time position, you will serve as our dedicated biller while also supporting other areas of the business. Additional responsibilities may include conducting research, assisting with social media, handling administrative tasks, developing systems and procedures, reviewing processes, and helping us build and grow our chiropractic and insurance operations.



Medical billing responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing patient information, insurance coverage, benefits, eligibility, deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, authorizations, referrals, and other payer requirements

* Verifying that patient demographics, insurance information, provider information, and billing records are accurate and complete

* Reviewing documentation and treatment records to confirm that services are properly supported for billing

* Reviewing chiropractic codes, including CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, modifiers, units, and diagnosis-to-procedure relationships

* Preparing and submitting clean electronic and paper claims to insurance companies

* Entering charges, payments, adjustments, write-offs, and other billing information accurately

* Monitoring claim status and following up with insurance companies regarding pending, delayed, rejected, or unpaid claims

* Identifying and correcting claim errors, clearinghouse rejections, coding issues, missing information, and payer-specific problems

* Handling claim denials, researching denial reasons, preparing corrected claims, and submitting appeals when appropriate

* Posting insurance payments and patient payments accurately and reconciling payment records

* Reviewing explanation of benefits statements, remittance advice, and payer correspondence

* Following up on unpaid balances, underpayments, overpayments, and incorrect insurance processing

* Managing accounts receivable and maintaining organized billing follow-up records

* Preparing patient statements and communicating professionally with patients regarding balances, billing questions, insurance processing, and payment responsibilities

* Coordinating with the chiropractic provider and office staff to obtain missing documentation or information needed for billing

* Maintaining accurate billing notes and documenting all payer and patient communications

* Tracking outstanding claims, appeals, authorizations, referrals, and other time-sensitive billing matters

* Monitoring payer deadlines and timely-filing requirements

* Assisting with credentialing, provider enrollment, payer enrollment, revalidation, and related insurance participation tasks, if needed

* Assisting with authorization and referral processes, including tracking approved visits and remaining authorized services

* Helping establish billing workflows, checklists, policies, and procedures for the chiropractic department

* Maintaining patient privacy and complying with HIPAA and applicable federal and California requirements

* Using Tebra and other billing, clearinghouse, payer, and office-management systems efficiently

* Preparing billing reports and providing updates regarding claims, collections, denials, accounts receivable, and other billing activity

* Identifying recurring billing problems and recommending improvements to increase accuracy, efficiency, and collections



We are looking for a dependable, long-term team member who is experienced, efficient, highly organized, and an excellent communicator. The ideal candidate should be able to work independently, take initiative, and contribute ideas as we develop this new area of the business.



Reliability is extremely important. You must arrive on time, communicate consistently during scheduled work hours, respond promptly to messages and requests, and remain available and engaged throughout your scheduled work time.



If you are applying for the full-time position, this role should be your primary full-time job. We are seeking someone who can dedicate their working hours and attention to helping our business grow.



If you already have another job but are interested in working with us only on an as-needed billing basis, that arrangement may also be considered.



Most importantly, whenever you are working with us, you must be fully focused on our business and perform no other work or personal activities during your scheduled hours.

title: rading Analyst & Strategy Collaborator (Hourly + Performance Bonus)
description:

Assist in maintaining Google Sheets portfolio trackers and automating data workflows.

Deep understanding of market mechanics, options strategies, and technical indicators.



Ability to articulate the why behind every trade setup—no gambling or gut-feeling trades.



Fluent English for live screen-sharing and strategy sessions.



Compensation:



A reliable hourly rate for research, backtesting, and strategy sessions.



Performance Bonus: Bonuses are tied to the net profitability of the setups you provide at the end of the month (factoring in both wins AND losses). You are compensated for calculated risk management, not just lucky wins.



To Apply, Include:



A link to your verified live trading track record.



A brief breakdown of a recent trade you took: include the setup that triggered your entry, the indicators used, and how you managed the risk.

title: Experienced U.S. Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
I am a U.S.-based real estate agent looking for an EXPERIENCED Real Estate Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for a long-term position.



This is NOT an entry-level position. I am specifically looking for someone who already has experience cold calling U.S. homeowners for a real estate agent, brokerage, investor, wholesaler, or similar real estate business.



Your primary responsibility will be making outbound calls to homeowners from lead lists that I provide, having natural conversations, identifying potential buyers/sellers, qualifying leads, and setting appointments for me to follow up.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Make high-volume outbound calls to U.S. homeowners

• Follow provided scripts while sounding natural and conversational

• Handle common homeowner objections confidently

• Identify homeowners who may be interested in selling

• Conduct circle prospecting and other real estate prospecting campaigns

• Call FSBO, expired, absentee-owner, high-equity and other provided lead lists as assigned

• Ask qualifying questions and identify motivation and timeline

• Set qualified appointments/callbacks for the agent

• Enter detailed notes and update every lead in the CRM

• Properly disposition calls in the dialer

• Follow up with leads when instructed

• Immediately flag hot leads for agent follow-up

• Follow all provided calling procedures, opt-out and Do-Not-Call instructions



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

• Minimum 1 year of REAL ESTATE cold-calling experience

• Previous experience calling U.S. homeowners

• Proven experience setting appointments from cold leads

• Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand voice

• Strong objection-handling skills

• Comfortable making a high volume of calls

• Experience using real estate CRMs and dialers

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Quality headset and quiet work environment

• Reliable attendance and ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



EXPERIENCE WITH THESE TOOLS IS A PLUS:

• Vulcan7

• Follow Up Boss

• PropStream

• Mojo, REDX or similar real estate dialers/lead systems



This is a long-term position for the right person. I am looking for someone who is confident, personable, persistent, organized and genuinely good at talking with homeowners — not someone who simply reads a script.



COMPENSATION:

$4–$5 USD per hour depending on experience, starting at approximately 20 hours per week. Additional hours and performance bonuses may be available based on results.



HOW TO APPLY:

Start your application with the words:

“READY TO CALL”

Applications that do not start with those words will not be considered.



Please include:

1. How many years of U.S. real estate cold-calling experience you have.

2. What type of real estate leads you have called (FSBO, Expired, Circle Prospecting, absentee owners, seller leads, etc.).

3. Which real estate companies/teams or types of companies you previously called for.

4. Which dialers you have used.

5. Which CRMs you have used.

6. Approximately how many outbound calls/dials you made per day.

7. Approximately how many qualified appointments you typically set per week.

8. Your requested hourly rate.

9. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

10. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile/resume.



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED

Send a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your real estate cold-calling experience.

Then include a short role-play as if you were calling a homeowner for the first time. I want to hear how you naturally open a cold call and handle the conversation.



If you have a previous cold-call recording that you are permitted to share, you may include that as well.

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Final candidates may be asked to complete a short paid calling trial before being offered the long-term position.

28 hours per week, fully remote

THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE

REQUIREMENTS

- Stable high speed internet, plus a backup connection (mobile hotspot) and backup power so an outage never stops your shift

- A reliable computer you can use for work

- Available for every shift listed above, including weekends



PREFERRED

- Previous admin, VA, or QC experience

- Experience with Dropbox, Google Sheets, and Slack

- Real estate photo or video experience is helpful but not required



WHAT WE OFFER

- Consistent, on time payments

- A structured two week training program with videos and written guides

- Long term opportunity with room to grow into more hours



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the words "Morning Delivery" so we know you read the full post. Then include:

1. Why you are a good fit for this role

2. Your admin or operations experience

3. Confirmation that you can work Tuesday to Sunday on the schedule above

4. A screenshot of your internet speed test and a short description of your backup internet and power

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER & PERFORMANCE EDITOR
description:
We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time role (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor focused only on pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who really understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Can follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOUR DAY TO DAY LOOKS LIKE

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd really like to hear from you.

title: Tiktok Shop video editor
description:
Hiring for part-time work for a Capcut / Adobe Premiere / TikTok editor



You will be making TikTok videos using Capcut or the video editing software of your choice.  The editing process is fairly simple and straightforward.  Anyone who is proficient in video editing should have no problem with the basic tasks such as:

Cutting dead space in talking head videos

Adding overlay images on screen in the videos

Minor effects such as dynamic zoom, cropping, etc.

Producing b-roll content from voiceover and footage provided, having the ability to digest what is being said and pair up the audio with corresponding footage

B roll: you need to be able to identify good clips from the bad clips, good voice lines vs the bad ones, this will get easier over time

Some videos will be very quick ~ 15 mins, some videos take longer to edit (clone style videos, b roll voiceovers)

I need someone thats not only a great editor but someone thats fast, you need to be able to edit at least 5-10 videos per day. The more videos you can do the more you will get paid with bonuses!

I need someone that wants to improve every video





Please review a few examples of my content to ensure you are familiar and comfortable with the editing style:

Basic talking head - here you are mostly editing dead space and piecing clips together, adding minor effects like crop and zoom to make the frames look more dynamic and seamless.





Talking head with overlays - same as before, but adding images provided to you on the screen to support what is being said in the video.


 





B-roll content - you will be provided a voice over and need to work through the footage to find fitting visuals. A strong understanding of English and social media content is crucial here.







You will be working hand in hand with me on an extremely viral social media page and there is room for bonuses if deadlines are met and the content performs well!

You are the brain and the hands. You look at the data, you make the creative decisions, and you produce the ad. We handle media buying — you handle everything else on the creative side.



This is not an entry-level position. We are only looking for someone who has real experience running native ads on Meta and can show real ad account metrics proving their natives perform. If you've never written and strategized native ads before — if you can't show CPAs, ROAS, or spend data from native campaigns you've worked on — don't apply.

- Analyze our ad account performance data and use it to d
 what to write next

- Choose the persona, the page, the angle, and the story structure for every native ad

- Develop and maintain persona pages that look and feel authentic

- Source or direct candid, scroll-stopping images that don't look like ads

- Constantly test new angles, personas, and story structures based on what the data tells you

- You understand persona pages, candid creative, and the entire native ad ecosystem

title: January Benefits Support | Temporary Intake Specialist
description:
Job Description

HPC is hiring temporary Intake Specialists to handle January benefit verifications so our permanent intake team can stay focused on new patients and daily inquiries.



Detail Information

Position: Temporary Intake Specialist, January Benefits Support

Role level: Level 1

Employment type: Temporary, fixed term

Assignment dates: Onboarding begins week of November 30; assignment ends approximately January 31



Schedule: Full time, Monday through Friday, business hours

Location: Remote

Reports to: Intake Lead and/or Admin Team

Pay: To be confirmed





About HPC

Healthcare Partners Consulting & Billing supports mental health and medical practices with billing, intake and revenue protection. Every January, patient insurance plans reset, and each active patient needs updated eligibility and benefits before their next session. Accurate verification protects our clients from denied claims and protects patients from surprise balances.

Position Summary



The Temporary Intake Specialist verifies insurance eligibility and benefits for existing patients across our client practices during January. You will work through payer portals and call insurance representatives when portal information is incomplete. You will document results in our systems and flag issues so they are resolved before the patient's appointment.



Key Responsibilities

Complete HPC training, shadowing and known-benefits tests between November 30 and December 11



Verify eligibility and benefits for assigned patients through payer portals and clearinghouse tools such as Availity



Call payer representatives when portal results are missing, unclear or conflicting, and record the call reference number



Confirm plan effective dates, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums and remaining visit limits



Identify prior authorization and referral requirements for behavioral health and outpatient services
