title: Marketing Strategist (Growth Strategy)
description:
### Marketing Strategist (Growth Strategy)



### Schedule and pay



Full-time at $10 USD per hour from day one. There will be a performance review after 90 days; it does not include an automatic pay increase.



Creative Nomads is looking for a high-level marketing strategist who can understand an organization's goals, diagnose what is limiting growth, and give the team a clear strategy to move forward. You'll work alongside Julius and our marketing, content, design, development, and account teams to help clients connect the right audience, message, experience, and follow-up to meaningful outcomes.



Your central responsibility is growth strategy and direction. SEO, paid advertising, targeting, analytics, and retargeting are tools you'll bring together within that strategy. Specialists will carry out the channel work, and you'll give them clear priorities, briefs, and ways to judge whether the work is helping.



### What you'll own

- Understand the client's business or organizational model, goals, audience, offer, current customer journey, and constraints before recommending channels or tactics

- Identify the most important growth bottleneck, distinguishing audience fit, positioning, awareness, conversion, follow-up, retention, and measurement problems

- Develop customer segments and targeting priorities based on needs, intent, fit, economics where relevant, and available evidence

- Shape positioning, messages, offers, and conversion paths so the right people understand the value and know what to do next

- Build practical 90-day growth roadmaps with a few clear priorities, hypotheses, resource estimates, dependencies, owners, and decision points

- Connect acquisition with the rest of the journey, including nurture, retargeting, conversion, and relevant retention, referral, or repeat-engagement opportunities

- Define meaningful outcomes and use analytics, funnel evidence, lead quality, and commercial or mission-related measures to evaluate progress without overstating attribution

- Guide SEO, paid-media, content, creative, and website specialists through useful briefs, reviews, and a shared understanding of the strategy

- Explain recommendations clearly to Julius, the account team, and clients: what we know, what we are assuming, why a priority matters, and what would change the plan

- Use evidence from results and customer feedback to refine the strategy, stop weak ideas, and help the team focus its effort



### How you'll work with the team

You'll own the quality and clarity of your strategic recommendations, roadmaps, briefs, and reviews. You'll support Julius and help coordinate the marketing team rather than take over every channel's daily execution.



SEO and ads specialists will handle channel execution and detailed optimization. Writers and designers will develop content and creative. Developers and analytics specialists will implement technical changes where needed. You'll understand these areas well enough to ask useful questions, challenge weak assumptions, and evaluate the evidence they bring back.



You'll collaborate with client and account stakeholders on sales handoffs, lifecycle improvements, and growth priorities. Changes to their processes, media spending, scope, and client commitments follow agreed approval limits. Your initial client portfolio and reporting line will be confirmed before an offer.



### What we need

- Evidence that you've diagnosed a marketing or growth problem and built a coherent strategy connecting audience, offer, positioning, journey, and measurable outcomes

- Strong customer segmentation and targeting judgment, including the ability to recognize when more traffic or more leads would not solve the underlying problem

- A practical understanding of funnels, conversion, nurture and retargeting, plus when retention, referrals or repeat engagement may be useful growth opportunities

- Analytical confidence: interpret funnel and channel data, distinguish events from business outcomes, assess lead quality and economics where appropriate, and make honest decisions with incomplete data

- Enough SEO, paid-media, content, creative, and conversion knowledge to direct specialists and evaluate their recommendations; hands-on media buying or SEO implementation is not the central requirement

- Ability to prioritize a small number of worthwhile initiatives within real budgets, team capacity, and approval boundaries

- Clear communication, accountable follow-through, and experience turning strategic decisions into briefs and work another person can execute

- Willingness to change a recommendation when evidence changes, explain a mistake, and protect confidential information

- Responsible use of AI or other research tools, with verification of important claims and ownership of the final work



Show us the work and the decisions behind it. A particular degree, certification, or fixed number of years is not required when you can demonstrate the relevant ability. Equivalent tools and transferable experience are welcome.



### Helpful, but not required

- Agency or multi-client strategy experience

- Experience with service businesses, nonprofit organizations, or other mission-driven organizations

- Customer research, positioning, lifecycle marketing, conversion research, or CRM/sales-handoff improvement

- Comfort interpreting GA4, Search Console, CRM, campaign, and reporting data with specialists

- Experience planning SEO or paid-media initiatives as part of a broader growth strategy

- Experience evaluating new channels such as LinkedIn or TikTok when the audience, offer and economics justify a test



### Your first 90 days

First 30 days: Learn a manageable initial group of clients, their goals, audiences, offers, current plans, and team responsibilities. Clarify the outcomes that matter, identify material measurement gaps, and present an evidence-based diagnosis of the leading growth constraints.



By 60 days: Agree focused growth roadmaps with Julius and the relevant stakeholders. Guide the first approved initiatives through clear specialist briefs. Establish a useful cadence for reviewing outcomes, assumptions, blockers, and decisions.



By 90 days: Evaluate the early evidence, separating what has been learned from what is still too early to conclude. Recommend what to continue, change, or stop, and set clear next-quarter priorities. Improve at least one recurring strategy, briefing, or review process. Account load and the number of initiatives will match agreed hours and team capacity.



### How success will be evaluated

- Clear diagnoses that connect the organization's goals to customer needs and a defensible growth priority

- Focused roadmaps and briefs that specialists can act on, delivered on agreed dates

- Useful measurement definitions, transparent assumptions, and early escalation of significant evidence gaps

- Approved experiments with a hypothesis, audience, resource boundary, success or stop criteria, and an honest readout

- Evidence of better qualified demand, conversion, engagement, retention, or efficiency where relevant and supported by the observation window

- Strong collaboration and client understanding, including clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through



Outcome targets will be agreed after reviewing baselines, budgets, implementation capacity, sales or service processes, and the client's business or mission. This role influences growth through sound strategy and coordinated execution; results also depend on decisions and work shared with the client and team.



### Apply with

Share one or two examples where your marketing judgment changed the direction of a project or organization. Explain the original problem, the audience and goal, your own contribution, the alternatives you considered, the plan you chose, and the evidence behind the result. Include a roadmap, strategic brief, or review if you can share one safely. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome; do not share confidential client information or account access.



The hiring process includes a short practical assessment using a fictional business and a follow-up conversation about your decisions. AI and reference tools are allowed with disclosure and verification.

description:
Are you someone who enjoys creating and following procedures, finding and researching software issues and working in a rewarding team environment? If so, then we would love to talk to you! We're seeking an experienced QA Engineer to join our team.



About the Role



On a daily basis, you will work with the Development team, UI/UX team, Technical Writing team, Support team, and other company members to help us produce high-quality web and mobile products to keep our customers productive, successful, and happy. 4. SQL experience. 

5. API testing experience.

SOCIAL MEDIA & AI CONTENT CREATION



This is one of the most important parts of the position.



We want to significantly improve our social media presence and produce professional-quality content on a consistent, daily basis.



You will:



• Create professional social media videos and content daily. 

• Turn real photos and videos from our automotive shop into polished content

• Use AI video, image, voice, editing, and content-generation tools to create high-quality videos

• Create content for Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Google Business Profile, and other platforms

• Develop content ideas independently rather than waiting for us to tell you exactly what to make

• Create educational, entertaining, promotional, and locally relevant automotive content

• Research trends and successful automotive social media accounts for ideas

• Maintain a content calendar and consistent posting schedule

• Help grow followers, engagement, reviews, website traffic, phone calls, and ultimately customers

• Track what content performs well and continuously improve our strategy



We expect you to be the expert in this area. You should be able to recommend new AI tools, techniques, content ideas, and strategies to us.



Applicants MUST provide examples of social media content and videos they personally created.



BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION & REPORTING



You will also function as an administrative manager for the business.



Responsibilities will include:



• Organizing and maintaining our digital filing system

• Filing and organizing invoices, documents, contracts, receipts, employee paperwork, and other business records

• Creating and maintaining spreadsheets

• Helping prepare weekly and monthly management reports

• Exporting and analyzing information from our Tekmetric automotive CRM/shop management system

• Tracking sales, repair orders, average repair order, customer activity, technician performance, gross profit, and other KPIs

• Using AI and spreadsheet tools to turn raw business data into useful reports

• Helping ownership identify trends and opportunities from our data

• Keeping recurring administrative responsibilities organized and on schedule

• Helping document processes and create better systems as the company grows



Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills are important.



GOOGLE, REVIEWS & ONLINE REPUTATION



You will help manage Brake World's online presence, including:



• Monitoring Google reviews and other online customer feedback

• Drafting professional responses to reviews

• Helping respond to online messages and inquiries

• Maintaining accurate business information across online platforms

• Looking for opportunities to increase positive customer reviews

• Helping ensure our online presence reflects a professional, trustworthy automotive business



BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & LOCAL OUTREACH



We want someone who is comfortable proactively helping us generate new business.



You will:



• Identify local businesses and organizations that could become Brake World customers

• Engage with local businesses through social media by following, commenting, and building relationships

• Send professional direct messages and
s introducing Brake World

• Call local businesses to introduce our company and discuss partnership opportunities

• Identify businesses operating multiple vehicles and build a database of potential fleet customers

• Cold call fleet prospects with the goal of establishing fleet service relationships

• Follow up consistently with prospects

• Track leads, conversations, follow-ups, and results

• Look for creative partnership opportunities with local businesses, HOAs, organizations, employers, and community groups



You must be comfortable speaking English on the phone with U.S. businesses. Excellent spoken and written English is required.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Our ideal candidate:



• Has professional social media management experience

• Has strong video editing and content creation skills

• Has significant experience using modern AI tools

• Can show us examples of high-quality videos and social content they personally created

• Understands how to make content look professional rather than like generic AI-generated advertising

• Is highly organized and detail-oriented

• Is strong with Excel and/or Google Sheets

• Is comfortable learning new software and CRM systems

• Has excellent written English

• Has strong spoken English and is comfortable making outbound calls

• Has experience with lead generation, appointment setting, cold calling, or business development

• Can work independently without needing constant instructions

• Notices problems and proposes solutions

• Learns new technology quickly

• Is dependable and interested in a long-term position



Experience with automotive businesses, Tekmetric, local business marketing, fleet sales, or U.S.-based companies is a plus, but not required.



AI EXPERIENCE IS IMPORTANT



We are an AI-forward company. We want someone who already understands how to use AI to work faster and produce better results.



Please tell us which AI tools you currently use and specifically how you use them.



Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Runway, Veo, Sora, Canva, CapCut, Adobe, ElevenLabs, or similar tools is valuable.



We are more interested in what you can actually create with these tools than simply seeing them listed on your resume.



COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY



Compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated capabilities.



This is intended to be a long-term position. Brake World is growing, and someone who performs extremely well will have an opportunity to take on additional responsibility as we add locations and expand the company. 



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and why you think you are a strong fit for this specific position.



2. Links to 3–5 of the BEST social media videos or pieces of content that YOU personally created. Please explain exactly what part of each project you created.



3. A list of the AI tools you currently use and how you use them.



4. A description of your experience with Excel, Google Sheets, reporting, CRM systems, or business administration.



5. A description of any cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, or business development experience you have.



6. Your expected hourly rate.



7. Your availability and preferred working hours.



8. Two professional references from previous employers or long-term clients, if available.



Finally, begin your application with the words “EVERY MILE” so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



Please do not apply if you cannot provide examples of social media/video work you personally created.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our team rather than simply complete assigned tasks.

title: B2B Cold Caller, Sales / Lead Generation Specialist, Appointment Setter, VA
description:
About the Role





We are looking for a highly motivated B2B Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate new business opportunities for a U.S.-based telecommunications Account Executive which is T-Mobile



The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, researching businesses, speaking with owners and decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales position. Your success will be measured by the number and quality of qualified appointments you generate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation



* Research and identify small and mid-sized businesses.

* Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, Google Search, business directories, LinkedIn, and other sources.

* Identify the business owner, manager, office manager, or person responsible for wireless/telecommunications.

* Find business phone numbers and available contact information.

* Prioritize businesses that are likely to have multiple employees, company phones, tablets, hotspots, or fleet vehicles.



2. Cold Calling



* Make outbound B2B calls to business prospects.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions professionally.

* Quickly identify whether the business is a potential fit.

* Ask discovery questions about their current wireless provider, number of lines, monthly spending, and pain points.

* Handle common objections professionally.

* Generate interest without being overly aggressive.



3. Appointment Setting



* Book qualified appointments directly on the Account Executive’s calendar.

* Confirm the appointment with the prospect.

* Send follow-up messages when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate appointment notes.

* Make sure appointments meet the agreed qualification criteria.



4. Follow-Up



* Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready to speak immediately.

* Re-contact previous leads.

* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.

* Track conversations and outcomes in the CRM/spreadsheet.



5. Sales Intelligence

The VA should identify opportunities such as:



* Businesses with 5+ employees

* Multiple business phone lines

* Companies with fleet vehicles

* Construction companies

* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Landscaping companies

* Pest control companies

* Roofing companies

* Delivery/courier companies

* Property management companies

* Medical/dental offices

* Professional-service businesses

* Salons/barbershops

* Other businesses likely to have multiple wireless users



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has B2B cold-calling experience

* Has appointment-setting experience

* Has strong spoken English

* Sounds confident and professional on the phone

* Is comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls per day

* Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

* Understands basic sales psychology

* Can identify decision-makers

* Can overcome common objections

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and communication tools

* Is highly motivated by performance and results



Performance Expectations



Daily targets:



* 50–100+ outbound calls

* 20+ meaningful conversations when possible

* 10–20+ newly researched prospects

* Consistent follow-up on previous prospects

* Accurate CRM/spreadsheet updates



Primary KPI:

Qualified appointments booked



Quality is more important than simply booking appointments. Appointments should ideally be with a business owner or decision-maker who has a legitimate need for business wireless services.



Qualification Questions



The VA should learn to determine:



1. Who is currently providing your business wireless service?

2. Approximately how many business lines do you have?

3. Are those lines company-owned or employee-owned?

4. Roughly how much does the business spend on wireless each month?

5. Are you currently under contract?

6. Are you experiencing any issues with your current provider?

7. Who makes the final decision regarding your wireless service?

8. When would you be open to reviewing another option?



The goal is not to hard-sell on the first call. The goal is to determine whether there is an opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto the Account Executive’s calendar.





If you’ve made it this far and read the role qualifications. Please send a virtual video of introducing yourself and why you are the best fit for this role.

title: Video Editor – YouTube Shorts

title: E-commerce Customer Support Specialist | Shopify, Email & Social Media
description:
WE ARE ONLY INTERESTED IN TALENT  

We’re building a culture, not a company.



Kitchwave is a growing e-commerce brand helping people make fresh juice, plant-based milk, and homemade drinks more easily.



Our vision is to build a trusted kitchen brand that customers feel confident buying from and recommending. We’re looking for an experienced E-commerce Customer Support Specialist who wants to take ownership of that customer experience and grow with us.



THE OPPORTUNITY AND VISION



We’re building Kitchwave for the long term, with people who take pride in their work and want to become exceptional at it. We want you to see a future for yourself in what we’re creating.



You’ll work directly with the founder, have one-on-one calls every two weeks, and receive established SOPs and response templates to support your work. These conversations are a chance to get direct feedback, discuss your development, and understand how your work affects the wider business.



You’ll have opportunities to sharpen skills you can use throughout your career and life: clear communication, sound judgment under pressure, problem-solving, and ownership. As you master the role, you can help improve our systems and develop the ability to train and lead others.



Joining at this stage means the improvements you make can become the standards future team members learn from. We want someone who takes pride in helping customers and is excited to help build the team they could one day lead.



Our culture is built on ownership and honest feedback. We value people who act on what they learn, follow through on commitments, and help the people around them improve.



This is a long-term, remote position with fixed monthly compensation. Strong performers can earn greater responsibility and grow into Lead roles as the team expands. Advancement depends on performance, leadership ability and grit.



SCHEDULE AND ACCOUNTABILITY



Your schedule must provide consistent coverage across all assigned channels and allow you to meet our performance expectations.



You’re responsible for monitoring incoming inquiries, responding promptly, and keeping unresolved cases moving. Response-time targets run continuously, including nights and days off, even when you’re not logged in.



We expect you to manage your workload independently, follow through on commitments, and flag workload or coverage problems before customers are affected. Consistently meeting the agreed performance standards is a requirement of this position.



CHANNELS YOU’LL MANAGE



- Customer
s.

- Customer text messages through Kitchwave’s Google phone number.

- Customer messages, DMs, and comments on
, Instagram, and TikTok.

- Customer reviews on our Kitchwave Shopify store, the Shop app, and Trustpilot.



These expectations apply to inquiries, comments, and reviews requiring a response.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



- **Response speed:** Maintain an average response time of two elapsed hours or less, aiming for one hour or faster. At least 95% of messages requiring a reply should receive a meaningful response within two elapsed hours. This includes initial inquiries and subsequent customer messages. Automated acknowledgments do not count. Performance is reviewed weekly by channel.



- **Resolution speed:** Resolve at least 90% of routine cases within one business day when the necessary information and authority are available. Resolve straightforward questions in the first response whenever possible. Cases awaiting a customer, fulfillment partner, or founder decision must have a documented blocker and next action.



- **Response quality:** Achieve at least 95% on reviewed conversations for accuracy, tone, completeness, and adherence to our policies. Replies must address the customer’s actual situation.



- **Follow-through:** Every unresolved case must have a next action and follow-up deadline. Complete follow-ups on time or flag a blocker before the deadline. Tickets must not be marked resolved simply to improve performance numbers.



- **Customer satisfaction:** Work toward at least 95% positive customer satisfaction feedback once measurement is in place, reviewed alongside response volume and conversation quality.



- **Chargeback prevention and support:** Contribute to Kitchwave’s company goal of a chargeback rate below 0.20% through proactive communication, timely handling of approved refunds, and early escalation of unresolved concerns. Complete all assigned dispute-documentation tasks by their deadlines. Individual performance will be assessed against the actions and cases within your control.



- **Accountability:** You own customer support across all assigned channels. You’re responsible for meeting your KPIs and following every case through to resolution. We expect you to take initiative and stay on top of the work without reminders or constant supervision. Keep the founder informed through a brief daily update.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



- Responding to customer
s, social media messages, DMs, and comments.

- Managing Shopify order issues, including approved cancellations, refunds, returns, exchanges, and replacements.

- Providing accurate shipping, tracking, preorder, and product-support information.

- Responding professionally to reviews on our website, the Shop app, and Trustpilot.

- Tracking unresolved cases, following up, and escalating issues when needed.

- Supporting chargeback documentation and improving our FAQs, templates, and support processes.



SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have hands-on experience providing customer support for a Shopify store. You should already know how to find orders, review payment and fulfillment status, check tracking, and process authorized order changes and refunds.



We’re looking for excellent written English, calm communication with frustrated customers, strong attention to detail, reliable attendance, and consistent follow-through.



Experience with Commslayer, Gorgias, Richpanel, or Zendesk is a plus.



READ THE FULL ROLE GUIDE BEFORE APPLYING



The complete responsibilities, expectations, and application details are here:







HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this listing and include:



1. Your Shopify customer support experience and the tasks you handled directly.

2. The support channels and software you have used.

3. Your previous daily ticket volume and response-time results, if available.

4. Confirmation that you can work the stated schedule and accept the advertised monthly compensation.

5. Why you want to grow with Kitchwave.



Shortlisted applicants will complete an interview and a paid practical assessment using sample customer situations.



If you’re loyal, diligent, and ready to take ownership of customer support as we grow, we’d like to hear from you.

Most of your day will be spent making high-volume outbound calls, filling open shifts, supporting workers, and ensuring daily staffing needs are met.



You'll work closely with both workers and the internal operations team to ensure shifts are filled quickly, workers receive the support they need, and clients receive excellent service. From time to time, you'll also assist with hiring and onboarding when there are high-priority hiring needs or new market launches.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor — Long-Form + Short-Form Content
description:
I’m looking for a video editor to join Kolbe 15, a founder community and media platform based in Toronto.

We produce founder conversations, panels, behind-the-scenes content, events, retreats, and social-first videos across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

I’m looking for more than someone who can make clean cuts and add captions. I need an editor with strong storytelling instincts who can take a large amount of raw footage and turn it into content people actually want to watch.

What You’ll Be Editing

Long-form content

- Founder conversations and podcasts, often 60–120 minutes

- Multicam footage, typically 2–3 cameras

- Multiple audio sources

- Panels, fireside conversations, and event content

- Full YouTube episodes

Short-form content

- Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts cut from long-form conversations

- Standalone talking-head videos

- Behind-the-scenes founder content

- Event and retreat promos

- Story-driven social content

What I’m Looking For

You should be highly proficient with a professional video editing platform such as Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent.

The software you use doesn't matter. The quality of your work does.

More importantly, you need strong editorial judgment.

You should be able to watch a long conversation and recognize:

- Where the story is

- What needs to be cut

- Where the pacing is dragging

- Which moments could become great short-form content

- How to create a strong opening or hook

- When B-roll, graphics, music, or sound design improve the story

- How to turn raw footage into something that keeps people watching

I’ll provide direction, context, and feedback, but I don’t want to direct every cut. I’m looking for someone who can learn our style and eventually take ownership of an edit from raw footage to finished content.

You Should Be Comfortable With

- Professional video editing software

- Multicam editing

- Syncing and working with multiple audio sources

- Audio cleanup and mixing

- Colour correction/grading

- Basic motion graphics

- Captions and on-screen graphics

- Music selection and sound design

- Editing in both 16:9 and 9:16

- Organizing and working with large amounts of footage

- Footage from professional cameras, iPhones, and Insta360 cameras

- Exporting for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn

Some of our content is in Farsi. You do not need to speak Farsi. Translations or transcripts will be provided when necessary.

Who You Are

I’m looking for someone who is creative, fast, reliable, organized, and proactive.

You communicate clearly. If something is going to be late, you say so.

You can take feedback and improve from one edit to the next.

You pay attention to details without needing every detail pointed out.

Most importantly, you think like an editor, not just an operator of editing software.

I want someone interested in learning our content, audience, and style and becoming a long-term part of what we're building.

To Apply

Please send:

1. Three examples of your best work — ideally at least one long-form/multicam piece and two short-form videos.

2. A brief explanation of what you personally did on each piece.

3. What editing software you primarily use.

4. How long you would typically need to turn a 60–90 minute, 3-camera conversation into a finished YouTube episode.

5. How many short-form videos you could realistically produce per week alongside long-form editing.

6. Your expected monthly rate in USD.

7. Your timezone and typical working hours.

Please don't send a generic portfolio with dozens of links. Pick the three pieces that best demonstrate what you can do.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid editing test using real footage before we make a final decision.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
CasCom is hiring for a full-time Senior Support Engineer



We need a senior engineer who is the last technical stop before the CIO.



Right now that last stop is the CIO, and that is the problem we are hiring to

fix. You would own escalations from our junior technicians, take directed work

from management, and carry your own tickets and projects through to sign-off.

You will be trusted to make the call and defend it, not to hand it back up the

chain.



If you are senior, you have run a real multi-client queue, and you are tired of

being the person who escalates rather than the person who d
, read on.





WHO WE ARE



CasCom is a managed technology services provider in Yellowknife, Northwest

Territories. We have been doing this since 1996. Our clients are federal,

territorial and Indigenous governments, mining and resource companies,

construction firms, financial institutions, hotels and remote industrial camps

across the Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon.



Many of our sites sit at the end of a satellite link in a community with no

local IT staff and nobody available to read a screen back to you. In winter

there is no road in. That constraint shapes how we work. We document, we

verify, and we do not guess on somebody else's production system.





WHAT THE WORK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE



These are real problems from recent months, with client names removed. If

reading them makes you want to start typing, you are the person we want.



 - An RMM-deployed installer succeeds across most of a fleet and fails on a

 stubborn subset with "Object reference not set to an instance of an

 object." Nothing in the logs separates the failures from the successes.



 - A user passes every Microsoft 365 policy and licensing check for a feature

 and still gets told they do not have permission. Policy propagation, client

 version and organizer scoping are all live possibilities.



 - A PowerShell script that ran fine last month now dies at sign-in because

 two Microsoft modules loaded in the same session disagree about which

 authentication assembly to use.



 - An EDR detection fires on a client server at 2 AM. You d
 whether it is

 noise or an i
, you start the clock on notification obligations, and

 you write it up so it holds up later.



 - A mailbox starts behaving strangely. You find the forwarding rule, work out

 what was taken and when, and explain it to a client executive who does not

 want a lecture on OAuth.



 - A hotel property's guest network saturates because IPTV shares a node with

 guest traffic. The fix is per VLAN bandwidth control on the edge firewall.



 - Guest devices at a property drop when they roam between access points. The

 answer is somewhere across VLAN tagging, controller configuration and RF

 coverage, and not cleanly inside any one of them.



 - Mail from a client domain starts failing authentication after a vendor

 changes its sending service, and you sort out SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment

 before the client's invoices stop arriving.



 - A delegated admin relationship to a client tenant lapses and your

 multi-tenant management portal quietly stops seeing that tenant.



Alongside that, you will carry project work through to completion: tenant

migrations, endpoint standardization, security tooling rollouts, and the

documentation that makes the next person's job possible.





WHAT WE RUN



 - Microsoft 365 and Entra ID in a multi-tenant environment, GDAP delegated

 administration, Conditional Access, Intune

 - Datto RMM and Datto EDR

 - Kaseya 365 User and Endpoint, RocketCyber, SaaS Alerts, Kaseya SIEM

 - Autotask PSA and IT Glue

 - CIPP for multi-tenant Microsoft 365 management

 - Enterprise edge firewall and UTM gateway platforms

 - Ubiquiti and Cambium wireless and network infrastructure

 - PowerShell and Microsoft Graph



You will not have used all of it, and we do not expect you to. Tell us honestly

what you have and have not touched. We would rather teach a strong engineer our

tools than hand our escalation queue to somebody who memorised a product list.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Required:



 - Five or more years in managed services or another multi-client

 environment. This is not a single-employer internal IT role and it does

 not behave like one.

 - Real Microsoft 365 and Entra ID depth. Not only user administration.

 Conditional Access, licensing, mail flow, and reading sign-in logs through

 to a conclusion.

 - PowerShell you write, not only PowerShell you run.

 - Working security fundamentals. You can triage a detection, recognise a

 compromised mailbox, find a malicious inbox rule, and explain what you

 found to somebody non-technical without frightening them or patronising

 them.

 - Written English strong enough that your ticket notes and client updates go

 out without editing. Half of this job is writing.

 - You finish things. You close the loop. You update the ticket before you go

 to bed.



Counts for a lot:



 - Hands-on Datto RMM, Datto EDR, Autotask, IT Glue or CIPP experience.

 - Ubiquiti and Cambium wireless. Controller administration, point to point

 links, guest network design and RF troubleshooting.

 - Firewall, VLAN and routing work on real edge devices.

 - Backup and disaster recovery, including a restore you actually performed.

 - I
 response against a framework such as NIST 800-61, and comfort

 writing the i
 report afterwards.

 - A documentation habit. IT Glue articles, SOPs, runbooks.

 - Automation and integration work against vendor APIs.





THE HONEST PARTS



We would rather tell you these now than after three rounds of interviews.



 - Remote only, working from the Philippines. The role does not relocate.

 - Our helpdesk runs Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM Mountain Time in Canada,

 which falls overnight in the Philippines. We need genuine overlap and we

 need you to be honest about what you can sustain over years rather than

 weeks.

 - You will be trusted quickly with client production systems and with

 administrative access across our managed base. Background and reference

 checks apply, and so does a confidentiality agreement.

 - Some weeks are i
 weeks. They are not the normal week, but they

 happen, and when they happen everyone works.

 - Our clients include governments and regulated organizations, so discretion

 is part of the job description rather than a bonus.





WHY THIS ONE IS WORTH YOUR TIME



You will see the whole stack rather than one slice of it. You will make

decisions instead of routing them. The environments are genuinely unusual:

satellite links, mine sites, Arctic communities, and organizations where the

nearest alternative technician is a flight away. Nobody here will ask you to

read from a script.





HOW TO APPLY



Send your CV to 
 with "Senior Systems Engineer" in the

subject line, and answer three questions in the body. Short answers are fine.

We care more about how you reason than about a tidy result, and the answers

matter more to us than the CV does.



 1. Tell us about one piece of work you owned from the first ticket through to

 sign-off while you were still carrying a live queue. What nearly derailed

 it, and what did you do about it?



 2. A user cannot do something in Microsoft 365. Every policy and licensing

 check you run says they should be able to. The client is asking for an

 update. Where do you go next?



 3. Your EDR fires on a client server outside business hours. What do you do

 in the first thirty minutes, and what tips it from noise into a declared

 i
?



Every application is read by a person, and we will come back to you either way.

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time, remote role (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars built from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We need someone who understands how ads work and why people buy.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO DOES WELL HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

title: Senior Developer
description:
## Senior Developer



WordPress, Astro and AI-assisted development



Creative Nomads is looking for a senior developer with the judgment to take ownership of complex web work from investigation through launch. You'll work across custom WordPress development, architecture, integrations, modern frontends, and the systems that help our team deliver reliably.



You should be comfortable stepping into someone else's code, learning an unfamiliar system, finding the real cause of a problem, choosing a practical solution, and leaving the next developer with clear documentation. We use AI in our work and expect you to use it thoughtfully while taking responsibility for the code, security, and results.



You'll work with our technical lead, developers, designers, QA team, and delivery managers. The goal is to give the team another senior developer who can own difficult work, help others improve, and turn prototypes and technical ideas into dependable releases.



This is a full-time role paying $10 USD/hour from day one. There is a performance review at 90 days, with no automatic pay increase.



The exact weekly-hour count, worker classification, working-time overlap, start date, and benefits will be confirmed separately.



## What you will own



- Build and extend WordPress websites with custom PHP, plugins, themes, JavaScript, APIs, and integrations. Work effectively with established builders while knowing when a custom solution is appropriate

- Build and maintain Astro frontends and CMS integrations, with attention to content structure, reusable components, responsive behavior, accessibility, and performance

- Investigate production and staging issues across PHP, plugins, databases, forms,
 delivery, APIs, caching, and hosting. Reproduce the problem, find the cause, verify the fix, and document it

- Investigate existing applications and inherited code without defaulting to a rewrite. Learn the architecture, trace behavior and dependencies, test your understanding, and turn uncertain requirements into small, testable implementation steps

- Plan safe CMS migrations. Preserve content relationships, URLs, redirects, access rules, media, and important user flows, and verify results before cutover

- Design maintainable integrations, including authentication, authorization, validation, retries, duplicate prevention, useful logs, and failure handling

- Improve development and release workflows using Git, pull requests, automated checks, staging, deployment verification, monitoring, and rollback plans

- Use AI coding tools to speed up investigation and implementation. Inspect generated code, verify behavior, protect client information, and explain your decisions

- Help automate repetitive WordPress maintenance with explicit permissions, tested backups, staged changes, and clear stop conditions

- Keep ClickUp work current, raise blockers early, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and help other developers solve recurring problems



## What you need to bring



- Evidence of independently delivering and supporting production WordPress work that goes beyond page-builder configuration

- Strong practical PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SQL skills, including the ability to read and debug an unfamiliar codebase

- Evidence of learning an unfamiliar system through code, documentation, data and targeted experiments, then making sound architecture or implementation decisions

- Experience building or maintaining custom WordPress plugins, hooks, themes, REST endpoints, or comparable integration-heavy WordPress functionality

- Working ability with Astro and a headless CMS workflow, including how content is built, previewed, fetched, and published

- Sound judgment around server-side authorization, validation, secrets, database changes, backups, and safe production access

- Practical Git, command-line, hosting, and deployment experience; comfort investigating logs and working with SSH and WP-CLI under appropriate access controls

- A repeatable approach to testing that covers expected behavior, failures, and regressions rather than relying only on visual inspection

- Demonstrated use of AI in real development work, with the ability to explain where it helped, what it got wrong, and how you checked the output

- Clear written communication, dependable follow-through, and the judgment to surface uncertainty before it becomes a missed commitment



## Experience that will help



- Taking over unfamiliar CMS or application code, documenting its behavior, and delivering a safe improvement or migration

- Sanity, Django or Wagtail, TypeScript, and other modern application frameworks

- GridPane, Cloudflare, CI/CD, uptime monitoring, and automated form or browser testing

- Membership systems, gated content, payment-provider integrations, CRM integrations, and complex forms

- Building guarded automation or MCP tools with scoped access, logs, approval boundaries, and recovery paths

- Mentoring developers and creating documentation that reduces repeat troubleshooting



We value your ability to learn and reason about an unfamiliar system. You do not need prior experience with every platform you may encounter here.



## What good work looks like here



- You clarify the outcome and important constraints before building

- Your changes are small enough to review, and your handoffs include evidence of what you tested

- You can explain what is ready, what is still risky, and what decision or access you need

- You protect existing user flows and data when changing or migrating a system

- The team can understand, operate, and maintain what you ship

- Your work makes the technical lead and the rest of the team more effective



## How to apply



Send a short introduction and two or three relevant examples. For each example, explain the problem, your personal contribution, the important technical decisions, and how you knew the result worked.



Please include:



1. A WordPress project involving custom code or a substantial integration

2. A difficult bug or production issue you personally diagnosed and resolved

3. A modern frontend, migration, or delivery-automation example, ideally involving Astro or a headless CMS



Public links are helpful. If the work is confidential, provide a redacted walkthrough or a small representative example you are allowed to share. Do not send credentials, private client data, or code you do not have permission to disclose.



Tell us your availability, working-time overlap, and when you could start. Shortlisted applicants will complete a scenario-based assessment and technical discussion. If a later coding practical is requested, its scope, time limit, and payment terms will be shared before it begins.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: GoHighLevel & Make.com Automation Builder
description:
AI AUTOMATION SYSTEMS BUILDER — NO LMTS AI

Northwest Arkansas (Remote OK) | Contract | $DOE — We pay well for the right person



---



WHO WE ARE



NO LMTS AI is an AI automation agency building full backend systems for home service businesses — dumpster rentals, HVAC, roofing, plumbing, landscaping, and more. We don't sell templates. We build custom, end-to-end operational systems that replace the manual work running these businesses. Our current client is Outbound Dumpster Rental, where we've built an AI receptionist, automated job pipeline, driver dispatch system, nightly route optimizer, and invoicing automation — all integrated and running without human involvement.



We're growing fast and need someone who can build at this level alongside us.



---



WHAT YOU'LL BE BUILDING



This is not a "set up a Zap" role. You will be building complex, multi-system automation architectures including:



- Full CRM builds in GoHighLevel (GHL) — pipelines, custom fields, tags, workflows with multi-branch logic, If/Else conditions, scheduled triggers, and internal notification systems

- AI voice agent builds in Retell AI — custom LLM prompts, function calling, webhook integrations, caller recognition, transfer logic, and GHL calendar booking

- Multi-step 
 scenarios — API calls to GHL, Samsara, Google Maps, Stripe, QuickBooks, and Google Sheets; webhook receivers; data transformation; scheduled batch processing

- Samsara GPS/telematics integration — geofence webhooks, driver tracking, API data pulls for efficiency reporting

- Stripe payment automation — invoice generation, recurring billing, payment link delivery via SMS

- Google Maps Directions API — route optimization across multiple stops with waypoint weighting and time window constraints

- QuickBooks integration — clean data push from GHL so transactions arrive pre-categorized

- Custom Google Sheets automation — auto-populated weekly reports built from multi-source data

- N8N and/or Zapier for specific integration bridges where needed



---



TECH STACK — YOU NEED TO KNOW THESE



Required (must be expert level, not familiar):

- GoHighLevel (GHL) — workflows, pipelines, custom fields, API, white-label setup

- 
 — complex multi-step scenarios, API modules, webhooks, error handling

- Retell AI — agent building, LLM prompting, function calling, webhook integration

- REST APIs — reading docs, building API calls, handling responses, authentication

- Stripe — payment links, recurring subscriptions, webhook events



Strong plus (you've built with these before):

- Samsara GPS platform and API

- Google Maps Directions API / Places API

- QuickBooks API or Zapier QuickBooks integration

- N8N

- Airtable or Google Sheets as a data layer

- Twilio or LC Phone for SMS routing

- OpenAI API or Claude API for agentic workflows



---



ON USING AI TOOLS



We use Claude heavily in our own build process and we encourage you to do the same. If Claude helps you move faster, understand an API, or work through a complex workflow — use it. We don't care how you get there. We care that you get there, that it works, and that it's built right. What we do require is that you actually understand what you're building. If something breaks, you need to be able to diagnose it — not just re-prompt your way out of it.



---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We need someone who:

- Has built real, complex automation systems — not tutorials, not demo accounts, actual client deployments

- Can read an API doc and build a working integration without hand-holding

- Thinks in workflows and data flows — you can map out a system on a whiteboard before you build it

- Communicates clearly when something is blocked, broken, or needs a different approach

- Can deliver a complete custom build in 2-3 days and handle 2-3 builds per week

- Is excited about what AI automation can do for small businesses — this matters to you, not just a paycheck



We do NOT need:

- Someone who needs to be told what to Google

- Someone who oversells their skill level — be honest about what you know and don't know

- Someone who disappears when a build gets hard



---



COMPENSATION



We pay well for good work, full stop. Rate is negotiable based on your skill level and what you can deliver. If you consistently hit 2-3 quality builds per week, you will be compensated accordingly — we have no interest in underpaying someone who performs. Name your number and we'll have a real conversation. We'd rather pay more for someone who executes than less for someone who can't.



This starts as contract/project-based with the potential to grow into a long-term role as we scale.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Don't send a generic resume. Send us:

1. Two or three systems you've built — describe what they do, what tools you used, and what was hard about them

2. Your honest skill level on each tool in our required stack (expert / proficient / familiar)

3. Your rate

4. How to reach you



Send to:

title: Experienced Script Writer for YouTube Channel FullTime
description:
I run an established YouTube channel with long-form videos around 45–60 minutes.



I'm looking for one experienced YouTube script writer to join us full time and long term.



The role starts with writing, but if you're good and we work well together, there's a path to taking on more of the channel and eventually becoming Channel Manager.



Pay: $650/month + bonuses when your videos perform well (which happens regularly on our channel).



THE ROLE



You'll take a video from topic to finished script:



- Research the topic properly

- Find the strongest angle and hook

- Build the structure

- Write the full 45–60 minute script

- Check your facts and sources

- Improve the script based on feedback



You'll get access to our existing scripts, successful videos and analytics so you can learn what works with our audience.



We're not looking for someone who can just write well. You need to understand YouTube.



Hooks, retention, pacing, curiosity, storytelling and knowing when a viewer might get bored all matter.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should already have experience writing long-form YouTube videos.



Strong English is important, but so is judgment. You should be able to read a lot of research, understand what's actually interesting and turn it into a story people want to keep watching.



You should also be fast, reliable, punctual, easy to communicate with and good at taking feedback.



This is a full-time position, not a side job. We use time tracking during working hours.



WHERE THIS CAN GO



If your scripts perform and you understand the channel, I'll gradually give you more responsibility:



- Finding and validating video ideas

- Reviewing analytics

- Planning content

- Reviewing other writers/research

- Checking edits

- Eventually helping run the channel



There's room for more responsibility, higher pay and performance bonuses as you grow.



I'm looking for someone who wants to stay for years.



HOW TO APPLY



Send everything in one message.



1. Your 3 best long-form YouTube videos that YOU personally wrote.



For each one, send the link, current views, video length and what you personally worked on.



2. If you have access to analytics, send screenshots showing:



- Retention after 30 seconds

- Average view duration / percentage viewed

- Retention graph



If you don't have access, that's fine.



3. Pick one of those videos and paste the exact hook/opening you wrote.



4. Find one long-form YouTube video from the last 6 months that got significantly more views than the channel normally gets.



Send the link and tell me in 3–4 sentences why you think it worked.



5. Tell me your time zone, availability and when you can start.



Don't send a long cover letter. Just send what I've asked for.



Write "retention" at the end of your application so I know you read the whole post.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



The best applicants will get a short paid writing test using material from our actual channel.



If you're good, you'll have stable full-time work, performance bonuses, room for raises and a real path to becoming Channel Manager.
